Ever-flowing, always full: πλυνοί Od. 6.86, ἀρδμοί Od. 13.247. 2 In neut. sing. ἐπηετανόν as adv., in never-failing abundance: ἐ. ἔχουσιν Od. 10.427. Cf. Od. 7.99. Ever, all the year round: γανόωσαι Od. 7.128.
ἐπήϊε 3 sing. impf. ἔπειμι2.
ἐπήϊξα aor. ἐπαΐσσω.
ἐπήϊσαν 3 pl. impf. ἔπειμι2.
ἐπῆλθε ἐπήλυθε 3 sing. aor. ἐπέρχομαι.

ἐπημοιβός [ἐπαμείβω. Cf. ἐπαμοιβαδίς.] 1 Of a garment, kept for a change ( = ἀμοιβάς): χιτῶνες Od. 14.513. 2 Of ὀχῆες, app., crossing each other(cf. ἐπαμοιβαδίς) Il. 12.456. (The κληΐς would secure the ὀχῆες to the gate at their point of intersection, and so make of the whole a solid structure without separate play in the parts.)

ἐπήν [ἐπεὶ ἄν.] When, after that. 1 With subj. in a relative sentence corresponding to sentences with εἰ 4. See Table at end (P) B.a.3. 2 With subj. or opt. in conditional relative sentences. For the examples and constructions see Table III.B.a 3, (D) (34) (35) (36) (38) (49) (65).
ἐπῄνησαν 3 pl. aor. ἐπαινέω.
ἔπηξε 3 sing. aor. πήγνυμι.
ἐπηπείλησε 3 sing. aor. ἐπαπειλέω.
ἐπηπύω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] To give one's voice in approval or assent to. With dat.: ἀμφοτέροισιν ἐπήπυον Il. 18.502.

ἐπήρατος -ον [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 19 + ἔραμαι. Lovely.] An epithet of general commendation, pleasing, charming, delightful, fair, or the like: δαιτός Il. 9.228: εἵματα Od. 8.366, ἄντρον Od. 13.103 = 347. As epithet of places, fair, pleasant: πτολίεθρον Il. 18.512, Il. 22.121. Cf. Od. 4.606.
ἐπήρετμος -ον [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 2 + ἐρετμόν.] 1 At the oar: ἑταῖροι ἥατʼ ἐπήρετμοι Od. 2.403. 2 Epithet of ships, fitted or furnished with oars Od. 4.559 = Od. 5.16 = Od. 17.145, Od. 5.141, Od. 14.224.
ἐπηρεφής [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 + ἐρέφω.] Overhanging: κρημνοί Il. 12.54. Of cliffs, beetling Od. 10.131, Od. 12.59.
ἐπήρκεσε 3 sing. aor. ἐπαρκέω.
ἐπῆρσε 3 sing. aor. ἐπαραρίσκω.
ἐπῇσαν 3 pl. impf. ἔπειμι2.
ἐπήσκηται 3 sing. pf. pass. ἐπασκέω.
ἐπητής App., well-mannered, courteous: οὕνεκʼ ἐ. ἐσσι Od. 13.332, ἐπητῇ ἀνδρί Od. 18.128.
ἐπήτριμοι -α. App., in succession, one after another: πυρσοὶ φλεγέθουσιν ἐπήτριμοι Il. 18.211. Cf. Il. 18.552, Il. 19.226.
ἐπητύς, -ύος, ἡ [ἐπητής.] Courtesy, gentle usage Od. 21.306.
ἐπήφυσε 3 sing. aor. ἐπαφύσσω.

ἐπί (Commonly with anastrophe when immediately following the vb. or case-form (and see Od. 3.161).) I Adv. 1 Position on or upon something, thereon: ἐπὶ δʼ ἀργύρεον ζυγὸν ἦεν Il. 9.187. Cf. Il. 7.223, Il. 11.630 (on the table): Od. 1.291, Od. 3.9, Od. 4.132, Od. 7.90, Od. 8.475, etc. 2 At a place, thereat: ἐπὶ σκέπας ἦν Od. 5.443 = Od. 7.282, Od. 6.210, Od. 12.336. 3 Denoting an occasion or cause, thereat, thereupon: ἐπὶ δὲ Τρῶες κελάδησαν Il. 8.542, γέλασαν δʼ ἐπὶ πάντες Il. 23.840. Cf. Il. 2.148, Il. 11.45, Il. 13.822, Il. 16.612, Il. 17.723, etc.: Od. 6.117. 4 Denoting (sometimes vaguely) that action, effort or the like takes place in a specified or indicated direction or is directed to or against something or to a specified or indicated object or end: κρατερὸν δʼ ἐπὶ μῦθον ἔτελλεν Il. 1.25, εἴ ποτέ τοι ἐπὶ νηὸν ἔρεψα (in thy honour) Il. 1.39, ἦμος ἐπὶ κνέφας ἦλθεν (came upon them) Il. 1.475, ἐπὶ φρεσὶ κέκασται (excels all) Il. 20.35. Cf. Il. 1.408, 528, Il. 3.461, Il. 4.384, Il. 9.539, Il. 10.99, Il. 11.235, etc.: ἀνέμων ἐπʼ ἀϋτμένα χεῦεν Od. 3.289, ἐπὶ χερσὶ μάσασθαι Od. 11.591. Cf. Od. 1.273, Od. 3.152, 161, Od. 8.245, Od. 14.195, Od. 17.241, Od. 18.64, etc. 5 Besides, in addition, too: ἐπὶ μέγαν ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι Il. 1.233, ἐπὶ ξύλα λέγεσθε Il. 8.507. Cf. Il. 5.705, Il. 15.662, Il. 18.529, Il. 21.373, etc.: Od. 12.399 = Od. 15.477, Od. 20.229. 6 Following, succession: πρὸ μέν τʼ ἄλλʼ, αὐτὰρ ἐπʼ ἄλλα Il. 13.799. Cf. Il. 13.800. 7 Accompaniment: ἐπὶ δʼ ἕψονται θεοὶ ἄλλοι Il. 4.63, ἐπὶ μείλια δώσω (δώσει) (with her) Il. 9.147, 289. Cf. Od. 9.297, Od. 12.349. 8 In answer or response: ἐπὶ δὲ στενάχοντο Il. 19.301 = Il. 22.515 = Il. 24.746, Il. 19.338, Il. 22.429, Il. 24.722. Cf. Il. 24.776. 9 Being in charge: ἐπὶ δʼ ἀνὴρ ἐσθλὸς ὀρώρει Il. 23.112. Cf. Od. 3.471, Od. 14.104. 10 To, towards, at, on, upon: ἦλθε δʼ ἐπὶ ψυχή Il. 23.65. Cf. Il. 11.480, Il. 23.232, etc.: γέροντας ἐπὶ πλέονας καλέσαντες (to the council) Od. 7.189, οἷον ἐπʼ ἦμαρ ἄγῃσιν Od. 18.137. Cf. Od. 11.84, 90, 632, Od. 12.427, Od. 18.1, etc. In hostile sense: ἐπὶ δʼ ὄρνυτο Il. 23.689. Cf. Il. 4.221, Il. 5.618, Il. 8.158, etc.: Od. 21.100. 11 On to, on, upon, over something: ἐπʼ ἄρα φάρμακα πάσσεν Il. 4.218, δέελον δʼ ἐπὶ σῆμά τʼ ἔθηκεν Il. 10.466. Cf. Il. 1.462, Il. 6.419, Il. 11.639, Il. 13.543, Il. 23.256, etc.: Od. 3.179, 459, Od. 8.443, Od. 10.520, Od. 12.47, Od. 19.58, etc. 12 Thrusting or pushing home: ἐπὶ κληῗδʼ ἐτάνυσσεν Od. 1.442. Cf. Il. 17.48. II Prep. 1 With dat. a On, upon: ἐπὶ χθονί Il. 1.88, ἐπὶ πύργῳ Il. 3.153. Cf. Il. 1.219, 462, Il. 4.248, 470 (over his body), Il. 5.42, etc.: Od. 1.211, Od. 3.5, 273, 408, etc. With locative: ἐπʼ ἰκριόφω Od. 3.353, Od. 13.74, Od. 15.283. Cf. Od. 5.59, Od. 11.607. In pregnant sense: ἐξ αὐτοὶ βαῖνον ἐπὶ ῥηγμῖνι θαλάσσης Il. 1.437. Cf. Il. 1.486, Il. 5.141 (against each other), Il. 11.5, Il. 13.359, Il. 22.97 (against), etc.: κατέθηκεν ἐπʼ ἀπήνῃ Od. 6.75. Cf. Od. 1.364, Od. 4.440, Od. 10.375, Od. 12.362, etc. With locative: ἐπὶ στεφάνην κεφαλῆφι θήκατο Il. 10.30: Od. 19.389. In reference to imposing, laying or conferring something upon a person: ἄλγεʼ ἐπʼ ἀλλήλοισι τιθέντες Il. 5.384, ἐπʼ αὐτῷ κῦδος ἔθηκεν Il. 23.400. Cf. Il. 6.357, etc.: Od. 11.524, Od. 19.592, etc. Sim.: εἰ γὰρ ἐπʼ ἀρῇσιν τέλος γένοιτο Od. 17.496. To bestowing a name: ἐπὶ πᾶσι τίθενται Od. 8.554. To attaching to something: δησάμενοι ἐπὶ κληῗσιν ἐρετμά Od. 8.37. b At, by, beside: ἐπὶ νηυσίν Il. 1.559, πηγῇς ἔπι κηφισοῖο Il. 2.523. Cf. Il. 2.472 (over against)), 788, Il. 7.86, Il. 12.168, Il. 22.93 (app., in the hole), etc.: Od. 1.103, Od. 2.391, Od. 4.40, Od. 6.52, Od. 9.103, etc. Sim., among, in the enjoyment of (wealth) Il. 9.482: Od. 1.218. In closer definition of something: οὔτασε χεῖρʼ ἐπὶ καρπῷ Il. 5.458. Cf. Il. 18.594, etc.: Od. 24.398, etc. With locative in reference to position: ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν Il. 13.308. Cf. Il. 13.309. c App., implying penetration, into, in: ἔγχος κατέπηξεν ἐπὶ χθονί Il. 6.213. Cf. Il. 23.876. So in reference to the mind, into, in: τῷ ἐπὶ φρεσὶ θῆκεν Il. 1.55, etc. Cf. Od. 5.427, etc. d For, with a view to: ᾧ ἔπι πολλὰ μόγησα Il. 1.162. Cf. Od. 18.44. In consideration of: μισθῷ ἔπι ῥητῷ Il. 21.445. Cf. Il. 10.304. In the case of, in the matter of, on the occasion of, in honour of, for: μητρὶ φίλῃ ἐπὶ ἦρα φέρων (to her) Il. 1.572, αἴθʼ οὕτως ἐπὶ πᾶσι χόλον τελέσειεν Il. 4.178. Cf. Il. 4.235, 258, Il. 9.492, Il. 14.67, Il. 17.400, Il. 21.585, Il. 24.82, etc.: τοιῷδʼ ἐπʼ ἀέθλῳ Od. 11.548, ἐπὶ μηρία θέντες Ἀπόλλωνι Od. 21.267. Cf. Od. 3.164, Od. 16.19, Od. 18.414, Od. 24.91, etc. e Besides, in addition to: ἄλλʼ ἐπὶ τῇσιν Il. 9.639, μή τις ἐφʼ ἕλκεϊ ἕλκος ἄρηται (wound on wound) Il. 14.130, τόσους ἐπὶ τοῖσι χιτῶνας Il. 24.231. Cf. Od. 3.113, Od. 11.287, Od. 22.264, etc. In comparison with: ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον Od. 7.216. f In reference to concomitance: ἀτελευτήτῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ (with your task unaccomplished) Il. 4.175, τῷδʼ ἐπὶ θυμῷ (with this . . .) Il. 13.485, ἐπʼ ἀρωγῇ Il. 23.574: ἀνηνύστῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ (with no end to the business) Od. 16.111. Cf. Od. 16.99, Od. 17.308, 454, Od. 24.511. At the hands of: ἐπὶ ἴστορι Il. 18.501. g After, following: τῷ δʼ ἐπὶ τυδεΐδης ὦρτο Il. 7.163. Cf. Il. 8.262, etc.: Od. 7.120, Od. 20.162, etc. h In charge or superintendence of, over: ἐπʼ ὀΐεσσιν Il. 5.137, υἱὸν ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι λιπεσθαι 154. Cf. Il. 6.424, etc.: σημαίνειν ἐπὶ δμῳῇσιν Od. 22.427. Cf. Od. 15.89, Od. 20.209, Od. 21.363, etc. i To, towards, in the direction of: νηυσὶν ἔπι Il. 5.327, ἕλκʼ ἐπὶ οἷ Il. 11.239. Cf. Il. 2.6, Il. 4.251, Il. 20.53, etc.: Od. 17.330, Od. 22.205, etc. Sim. πατρόκλῳ ὅγʼ ἐπʼ ὀφρύσι νεῦσεν Il. 9.620. In reference to lighting or coming upon something: ἐπὶ σώματι κύρσας Il. 3.23. Cf. Il. 23.821. In hostile sense, against, upon: ἧκεν ἑπʼ Ἀργείοισι βέλος Il. 1.382, ἐπʼ ἀλλήλοισι θορόντες Il. 11.70. Cf. Il. 3.15, Il. 5.124, Il. 8.327, Il. 11.294, etc.: Od. 2.316, Od. 10.214, Od. 13.60, Od. 22.8, etc. So ἐφʼ ἵπποιιν μάστιγας ἄειραν Il. 23.362. Of laughing at or exulting over a person: ἐπʼ αὐτῷ γέλασσαν Il. 2.270, Il. 23.784, τῷ δʼ ἐπὶ μακρὸν ἄϋσεν Il. 5.101, etc.: Od. 20.358 = Od. 21.376. Cf. Od. 20.374, Od. 22.412. In reference to position, in the direction of, towards: ἐπὶ οἷ τετραμμένον Il. 13.542. j In reference to time. α During, for the space of: ἐπʼ ἤματι δακρύσαντας Il. 19.229. Cf. Il. 8.529. β During, on: ὄς τις ἐπʼ ἤματι τῷδε μεθίῃσι μάχεσθαι Il. 13.234. Cf. Il. 19.110: ἐπʼ ἤματι μῆλον ἀγινεῖ (each day, day by day) Od. 14.105. γ In the space of: τοσσάδε μέρμερʼ ἐπʼ ἤματι μητίσασθαι (in a single day) Il. 10.48: τρὶς ἐπʼ ἤματι Od. 12.105. Cf. Od. 2.284. 2 With acc. a To, towards, in the direction of: ἐπὶ νῆας Il. 1.12, τώ οἱ ὤμω ἐπὶ στῆθος συνοχωκότε Il. 2.218, ἀταρπιτὸς ἦεν ἐπʼ αὐτήν (leading to it) Il. 18.565. Cf. Il. 1.306, 440, Il. 2.808, Il. 4.78, etc.: Od. 1.149, 183, 274, Od. 2.260, etc. So ἐπὶ δεξιά Il. 7.238, etc. In hostile sense Il. 5.590, Il. 13.101, etc.: Od. 17.295. In quest of, for: ἐπὶ Νέστορα Il. 10.54. Cf. Il. 2.18, etc.: Od. 3.421, etc. In reference to that to which one turns or proceeds: ἐπὶ ἔργα τράποντο Il. 3.422. Cf. Il. 2.381, etc.: Od. 8.395, Od. 14.455, Od. 24.394, etc. To directing the sight or voice: γεγωνέμεν ἐπʼ Αἴαντος κλισίας Il. 11.7, ἐπὶ Θρῃκῶν καθορώμενος αἶαν Il. 13.4, etc. To seeing to something: ἐπὶ ἔργα ἰδεῖν Od. 16.144. To being brought into sorrow Od. 14.338. In view of, for: πᾶσαν ἐπʼ ἰθύν Il. 6.79: Od. 4.434. b Indicating arrival at a point: ἐπὶ κλισίας ἱκέσθην Il. 1.328. Cf. Il. 2.17, etc.: Od. 10.117, Od. 12.430, etc. In reference to time: οὐδʼ ἐπὶ γῆρας ἵκετο Od. 8.226. c In reference to adjusting to, bringing into conformity with, something: ἐπὶ ἶσα Il. 12.436 = Il. 15.413: ἐπὶ στάθμην Od. 5.245, Od. 17.341 = Od. 21.44, Od. 21.121, Od. 23.197. To bringing into a specified formation: ὅς τίς σφιν ἐπὶ στίχας ἡγήσαιτο (into their ranks) Il. 2.687. Cf. Il. 3.113. To being in such a formation: θρέξασκον ἐπὶ στίχας Il. 18.602. Sim.: ἐπὶ πτολέμοιο γεφύρας ἥατο Il. 8.553. d On, upon. In reference to placing, setting, seating or sitting on or at something: ἕζετο θῖνʼ ἔφʼ ἁλός Il. 1.350, θῖνʼ ἔφʼ ἁλὸς εἰρυμέναι Il. 13.682. Cf. Il. 8.442, etc.: εἷσαν ἐπὶ σκέπας Od. 6.212. Cf. Od. 12.171, etc. Sim.: ἐπʼ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ἵζει Il. 13.281, ἑζόμενος ἐπὶ γοῦνα (i.e. with his knees on the ground, sitting on his heels) Il. 14.437. In reference to attaching: ἔδησαν ἐπʼ ὀμφαλόν Il. 24.273. To falling on a part of the body: ἐπὶ στόμα Il. 6.43. Cf. Il. 5.586, etc. To a part by which one is seized: ἑλὡν ἐπὶ μάστακα Od. 23.76. e In reference to position, on, at: νηῶν ἐπʼ ἀριστερά Il. 13.675. Cf. Il. 2.526, Il. 5.355, etc.: Od. 3.171, Od. 5.277. f On to, on: ἐπὶ πύργον ἰοῦσαν Il. 3.154, ἀποβάντες ἐπὶ χθόνα Il. 8.492. Cf. Il. 6.375, Il. 12.448, Il. 17.504, Il. 23.393, etc.: Od. 17.413, Od. 22.2, etc. g In reference to motion over or on something: πᾶσαν ἐπʼ αἶαν Il. 9.506, ἐλάαν ἐπὶ κύματα Il. 13.27. Cf. Il. 2.159, Il. 14.254, Il. 19.378, Il. 20.227, Il. 23.320, etc.: Od. 1.97, Od. 2.364, Od. 5.175, Od. 6.138, etc. In reference to directing the sight: ὁρόων ἐπὶ πόντον Il. 1.350, etc. Cf. Od. 5.84, etc. h In reference to pouring liquid over or on something: ὕδωρ ἐπὶ χεῖρας ἔχευαν Il. 3.270, etc. Cf. Od. 1.146, etc. And in gen., to diffusion, distribution, extent, existence, over or on a space or tract: Ἠὼς ἐκίδνατο πᾶσαν ἐπʼ αἶαν Il. 8.1, κλέος κέ οἱ εἴη πάντας ἐπʼ ἀνθρώπους (among them) Il. 10.213. Cf. Il. 7.63, 446, Il. 17.447, Il. 23.226, 742, etc.: Od. 3.3, Od. 4.417, Od. 7.332, Od. 12.386, Od. 14.403, Od. 17.386, etc. To a surface on which a characteristic is displayed: ἐπὶ νῶτα δαφοινός Il. 2.308. Sim.: [ἵππους] σταφύλῃ ἐπὶ νῶτον ἐΐσας (as measured across their backs) Il. 2.765. i In reference to going among, over or round persons: οἰχόμενοι ἐπὶ πάντας Il. 14.381. Cf. Il. 20.353: Od. 3.252. Sim.: πόλλʼ ἐπὶ ἄστεʼ ἀλώμενος Od. 15.492, Od. 19.170. Cf. Od. 16.63. In reference to division or distribution among persons: δασσάμενοι ἐφʼ ἡμέας Od. 16.385. j In reference to extent or distance: ὅσον τʼ ἐπὶ λᾶαν ἵησιν Il. 3.12. Cf. Il. 15.358, Il. 17.368, etc.: Od. 5.251, Od. 11.577 (covering), etc. k In reference to a part of the body on which one lies: ἐπὶ πλευρὰς κατακείμενος Il. 24.10. l In reference to time, for, during: μείνατʼ ἐπὶ χρόνον Il. 2.299. Cf. Il. 9.415, etc.: Od. 12.407, etc. Sim.: εὗδον ἐπʼ ἠῶ καὶ μέσον ἧμαρ (on through . . .) Od. 7.288. 3 With genit. a On, upon: ἐπʼ ὤμων Il. 1.46, ἐπʼ ἠϊόνος Il. 23.61. Cf. Il. 5.550, Il. 11.38, Il. 20.229 (see ἄκρος 3), Il. 22.225, etc.: Od. 1.162, 171, Od. 5.33, 82, Od. 10.170, etc. In reference to leaning on a part of the body: ὀρθωθεὶς ἐπʼ ἀγκῶνος Il. 10.80. To the part of a thing on which it stands: ἔγχεʼ ἐπὶ σαυρωτῆρος ἐλήλατο (i.e. were driven in by the butt) Il. 10.153. In pregnant sense: ἐπʼ ἠπείροιο ἔρυσσαν Il. 1.485. Cf. Il. 3.293, Il. 18.422, Il. 24.190, etc.: τίθει ἐπʼ ἀπήνης Od. 6.252. Cf. Od. 7.162, Od. 9.85, Od. 15.547, etc. b At, by, in: ἐπὶ βουπρασίου Il. 11.756. Cf. Il. 18.557, Il. 22.153: μύλης ἔπι Od. 7.104. Cf. Od. 1.185, Od. 5.489, Od. 9.140, etc.–At anchor: ἐπʼ εὐνάων Il. 14.77. c Towards, in the direction of: ἐπὶ νηῶν Il. 5.700. Cf. Il. 3.5, Il. 11.546, Il. 21.454, Il. 23.374, etc.: Od. 3.171, Od. 5.238, etc. Sim., app., to oneself, withdrawn into oneself: σιγῇ ἐφʼ ὑμείων Il. 7.195. With a form in -φιν: ἐπʼ αὐτόφιν ἥατο σιγῇ Il. 19.255. d Along with, with: ὅσσα ἔοικεν ἐπὶ παιδὸς ἕπεσθαι Od. 1.278 = Od. 2.197. e In reference to time, in the time of, in the days of: ἐπʼ εἰρήνης Il. 2.797. Cf. Il. 5.637, etc. So, app., ἐπὶ δώρων (in the time of gifts, not delaying and so missing the reward) Il. 9.602.

data.quote: πρὸ μέν τʼ ἄλλʼ, αὐτὰρ ἐπʼ ἄλλα
δέελον δʼ ἐπὶ σῆμά τʼ ἔθηκεν
ἐξ αὐτοὶ βαῖνον ἐπὶ ῥηγμῖνι θαλάσσης
εἰ γὰρ ἐπʼ ἀρῇσιν τέλος γένοιτο
αἴθʼ οὕτως ἐπὶ πᾶσι χόλον τελέσειεν
μή τις ἐφʼ ἕλκεϊ ἕλκος ἄρηται
ὄς τις ἐπʼ ἤματι τῷδε μεθίῃσι μάχεσθαι
τώ οἱ ὤμω ἐπὶ στῆθος συνοχωκότε
ὅς τίς σφιν ἐπὶ στίχας ἡγήσαιτο
κλέος κέ οἱ εἴη πάντας ἐπʼ ἀνθρώπους
εὗδον ἐπʼ ἠῶ καὶ μέσον ἧμαρ

definition: ἔπι [for ἔπ-εστι.] There is in a specified or indicated place, affecting or characterizing a specified or indicated person, or the like. With or without dat.: οὔ τοι ἔπι δέος Il. 1.515, καλὸν εἶδος ἔπι Il. 3.45. Cf. Il. 5.178, etc.: ᾧ ἔπι κώπη Od. 8.403. Cf. Od. 2.58, Od. 11.367, Od. 14.92, etc.
†ἐπιάλλω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. ἐπί̄ηλε. To set on foot, instigate: τάδε ἔργα Od. 22.49.
ἐπιάλμενος aor. pple. ἐφάλλομαι.

ἐπιανδάνω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. impf. ἐφήνδανε Il. 7.45. To please, be pleasing or acceptable. With dat.: βουλὴ θεοῖσιν Il. 7.45. Cf. Od. 13.16, Od. 16.406, = Od. 20.247, Od. 18.50 = 290 = Od. 21.143 = 269. Impers.: ἐμοὶ ἐπιανδάνει οὕτως Il. 7.407.

†ἐπιάχω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 pl. impf. ἐπί̄αχον (or rather (cf. under ἰάχω) aor. ἐπίϝαχον, or with augment ἐπέϝαχον, ἐπεύαχον). To shout in approval or assent Il. 7.403 = Il. 9.50. In answer or defiance Il. 5.860 = Il. 14.148, Il. 13.835.
ἐπίβαθρον [ἐπιβα-, ἐπιβαίνω.] A return made for a passage in a ship Od. 15.449.

ἐπιβαίνω [ἐπι- 11 12 (14).] A Aor. ἐπέβην Od. 10.347, Od. 11.167, 482. 1 pl. -ημεν Od. 9.83. 3 pl. -ησαν Od. 22.424. ἐπέβαν Od. 23.238. 2 dual subj. ἐπιβῆτον Od. 23.52. 1 pl. ἐπιβήομεν Od. 6.262, Od. 10.334. Opt. ἐπιβαίην Il. 5.192: Od. 5.177. 2 sing. -αίης Il. 14.299. 3 sing. -αίη Il. 5.666: Od. 12.77. 3 pl. -αῖεν Il. 8.512. Pple. ἐπιβάς, -ᾶσα Il. 4.99, Il. 5.328, Il. 14.226, Il. 15.387: Od. 5.50, Od. 10.480, Od. 13.319. Infin. ἐπιβήμεναι Il. 9.133, 275, Il. 19.176: Od. 7.196, Od. 10.340, 342, Od. 12.282, Od. 14.229. ἐπιβῆναι Od. 5.399, Od. 12.434. 2 sing. fut. in mid. form ἐπιβήσεαι Il. 8.165. Dat. pl. masc. pple. ἐπιβησομένοισι Il. 23.379. 3 sing. aor. ἐπεβήσετο (ἐπιβήσετο) Il. 8.44, Il. 10.513, 529, Il. 11.517, Il. 13.26, Il. 24.322: Od. 4.521, Od. 6.78. Imp. ἐπιβήσεο Il. 5.221, Il. 8.105, Il. 11.512. Acc. sing. masc. pple. ἐπιβησόμενον Il. 5.46, Il. 16.343. B Fut. infin. ἐπιβησέμεν Il. 8.197. 3 sing. aor. ἐπέβησε Il. 8.129, Il. 9.546. 3 pl. -ησαν Od. 23.13. 2 pl. subj. ἐπιβήσετε Od. 7.223. Imp. ἐπίβησον Il. 8.285. I Intrans. in all forms except those under (B). 1 With genit., to set foot upon, get upon: πύργων Il. 8.165. Cf. Il. 12.444. Of horses Il. 23.379. Absol. Il. 15.387: Od. 12.77, 434. To embark upon (a ship or raft): νεῶν Il. 8.512: σχεδίης Od. 5.177. Cf. Od. 4.708, Od. 9.101, Od. 13.319. Of landing from a ship upon: πατρίδος αἴης Od. 4.521. Cf. Od. 7.196, Od. 9.83, Od. 11.167, 482, Od. 12.282. So of coming to shore out of the sea: ἠπείρου Od. 5.399. Cf. Od. 23.238. To mount (a chariot, etc.): ἵππων Il. 5.46. Cf. Il. 5.192, 221, Il. 8.44, Il. 11.512, Il. 24.322, etc.: Od. 6.78. To mount (a horse): ἵππων ἐπεβήσετο (app. meaning one of them) Il. 10.513, 529. To mount, place oneself upon (a bed): εὐνῆς Il. 9.133 = 275 = Il. 19.176: Od. 10.334, 340, 342, 347, 480. Of a corpse, to take its place, be placed, upon (the pyre): πυρῆς Il. 4.99. 2 To make one's way to, proceed to. With genit.: πόληος Il. 16.396: Od. 14.229. So to make one's way to and reach: πόλιος Od. 6.262. 3 To set foot within; hence, fig., with genit., to have enjoyment of: ἐϋφροσύνης Od. 23.52. To embark upon a course of, give oneself up to: ἀναιδείης Od. 22.424. 4 To traverse by flying over. With acc.: πιερίην Il. 14.226: Od. 5.50. 5 Absol., to go on one's own feet (as opposed to being carried) Il. 5.666. II Trans. in forms (B). 1 With genit., to cause to embark upon (a ship): Ἀχαιοὺς νηῶν ἐπιβησέμεν Il. 8.197. To set on shore from a ship upon: ἐμῆς πάτρης Od. 7.223. To cause to mount (a chariot): ἵππων Il. 8.129. To cause (a person) to take his place upon (the pyre) (i.e. slay him): πολλοὺς πυρῆς ἐπέβησεν Il. 9.546. 2 Fig., with genit., to bring within the pale of, bring into the enjoyment of: ἐϋκλείης Il. 8.285. To bring into a course of, lead to adopt: σαοφροσύνης Od. 23.13.

ἐπιβάλλω [ἐπι- 11 12.] 1 To throw or cast upon something indicated Il. 23.135. To lay on (the lash): ἱμάσθλην Od. 6.320. 2 In mid., to throw oneself upon in eagerness to possess. With genit.: ἐνάρων ἐπιβαλλόμενος Il. 6.68. 3 Of a ship, app., to head towards, stand for. With acc.: φεὰς ἐπέβαλλεν Od. 15.297.
ἐπιβάς aor. pple. ἐπιβαίνω.
ἐπιβάσκω [ἐπι- 11.] Like ἐπιβαίνω II.2. to bring within the pale of, involve in. With genit.: κακῶν υἷας Ἀχαιῶν Il. 2.234.
ἐπιβήμεναι ἐπιβῆναι aor. infin. ἐπιβαίνω.
ἐπιβήομεν 1 pl. aor. subj. ἐπιβαίνω.
ἐπιβήσεαι 2 sing. fut. mid. ἐπιβαίνω.
ἐπιβήσεο aor. imp. mid. ἐπιβαίνω.
ἐπίβησον trans. aor. imp. ἐπιβαίνω.
ἐπιβήτωρ -ορος, ὁ [ἐπιβη-, ἐπιβαίνω.] 1 One who mounts (a chariot), a (skilled) fighter from the chariot Od. 18.263. 2 Of an animal, the mounter, the male or mate Od. 11.131 = Od. 23.278.

ἐπιβλής ὁ [ἐπι- 18 + βλη-, βάλλω.] App., a movable piece of wood to secure a gate, passing through a hole in one gate-post and fitting into a socket in the other Il. 24.453 (no doubt identical with the κληΐς of 455).

†ἐπιβοάω [ἐπι- 5.] Fut. mid. ἐπιβώσομαι Od. 1.378, Od. 2.143. 1 pl. ἐπιβωσόμεθα (v.l. ἐπιδωσόμεθα) Il. 10.463. In mid., with acc., to call to for aid: θεούς Od. 1.378 = Od. 2.143. App., to call to in thanksgiving: Ἀθήνην Il. 10.463.

ἐπιβουκόλος [ἐπι- 10 + βουκόλος. Pleonastically, the herdsman in charge of (the herd). Cf. ἐπιβώτωρ, ἐπίουρος, ἐπιποιμήν, μετάγγελος.] A herdsman: βοῶν Od. 3.422, Od. 20.235 = Od. 21.199, Od. 22.268, 285, 292.
ἐπιβρέμω [ἐπι- 5.] Of wind, to roar upon (and fan). With acc.: πῦρ Il. 17.739.

†ἐπιβρίθω (ῑθ) [ἐπι- 5.] 3 pl. aor. ἐπέβρῖσαν Il. 12.414. 3 sing. subj. ἐπιβρί̄σῃ Il. 5.91, Il. 7.343, Il. 12.286. 3 pl. opt. ἐπιβρί̄σειαν Od. 24.344. 1 To bear or press heavily upon someone: μὴ ἐπιβρίσῃ πόλεμος Il. 7.343. To bring one's weight to bear upon the foe: μᾶλλον ἐπέβρισαν Il. 12.414. 2 Of rain or snow, to fall destructively or in excessive abundance Il. 5.91, Il. 12.286. To fall in suitable abundance Od. 24.344.
ἐπιβώσομαι fut. mid. ἐπιβοάω.
ἐπιβώτωρ -ορος, ὁ [ἐπι- 10 + βώτωρ. Cf. ἐπιβουκόλος.] A shepherd or goatherd: μήλων Od. 13.222.
ἐπιγίγνομαι [ἐπι- 7.] To succeed, come on in due succession: [ἀλλὰ φύλλα] ἔαρος ἐπιγίγνεται ὥρῃ Il. 6.148. (V.l. ἔαρος ἐπιγίγνεται ὥρη.)
†ἐπιγιγνώσκω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. aor. subj. ἐπιγνώῃ Od. 24.217. 3 pl. ἐπιγνώωσι Od. 18.30. 1 To look upon, watch, see Od. 18.30. 2 To recognize Od. 24.217.

ἐπιγνάμπτω [ἐπι- 11.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέγναμψε Il. 2.14, 31, 68. Pple. ἐπιγνάμψας Il. 21.178. Fem. ἐπιγνάμψασα Il. 1.569. 1 To bend towards oneself: δόρυ Il. 21.178. 2 Fig., to bend, influence: νόον Il. 9.514. To bend to one's purpose, bring over to one's views Il. 2.14 = 31 = 68. 3 To put restraint upon, restrain, repress: κῆρ Il. 1.569.
ἐπιγνώῃ 3 sing. aor. subj. ἐπιγιγνώσκω.
ἐπιγουνίς -ίδος, ἡ [ἐπι- 1 + γουν-, γόνυ.] The great extensor muscle of the thigh Od. 17.225, Od. 18.74.
ἐπιγράβδην [ἐπιγράφω.] Grazing, inflicling a superficial wound: πῆχυν ἐ. βάλεν Il. 21.166.

†ἐπιγράφω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέγραψε Il. 4.139: Od. 22.280. Pple. ἐπιγράψας Il. 7.187, Il. 11.388. Infin. ἐπιγράψαι Il. 13.553. 1 To graze, inflict a superficial wound upon: χρόα Il. 4.139. Cf. Il. 11.388, Il. 13.553 (here, app., simply, to touch or reach): Od. 22.280. 2 To scratch a mark upon: κλῆρον Il. 7.187.

data.ref: Il. 13.553 (here, app., simply, to touch or reach):

definition: ἐπιδέδρομε 3 sing. pf. ἐπιτρέχω.

ἐπιδέξιος -ον [ἐπι- 11 + δεξιός.] In neut. pl. ἐπιδέξια as adv., (in sequence) from left to right, in the sun's direction (i.e. in the lucky order): ὄρνυσθʼ ἑξείης ἐ. Od. 21.141. App., on the right hand (i.e. in the lucky quarter): ἀστράπτων Il. 2.353.

ἐπιδευής -ές [ἐπιδεύομαι.] Contr. pl. ἐπιδευεῖς Il. 9.225, Il. 13.622. 1 Needy, in want Il. 5.481. 2 With genit., lacking, lacking in, being without, not having: κρειῶν Il. 12.299. Cf. Il. 13.622: Od. 4.87. Suffering want or being stinted in the matter of: δαιτὸς ἐΐσης Il. 9.225. Falling short of: βίης Ὀδυσῆος Od. 21.253. Falling short in the matter of: βίης Od. 21.185. Absol., lacking the necessary strength Od. 24.171. 3 In neut. ἐπιδευές as abstract sb., lack: ἵνα μή τι δίκης ἐ. ἔχῃσθα Il. 19.180.

data.quote: ἵνα μή τι δίκης ἐ. ἔχῃσθα

definition: ἐπιδεύομαι [ἐπι- 19 + δεύομαι. See δεύω2.] With genit., to lack, find or feel the want of: σεῦ Il. 18.77: τούτων Od. 15.371. To fall short of (a person): κείνων ἀνδρῶν Il. 5.636. To be unequal to, unfitted for: μάχης Il. 23.670, μάχης Ἀχαιῶν (against the . . .) Il. 24.385. To stand in need of, seek to get, desire: χρυσοῦ Il. 2.229.
ἐπιδέω [ἐπι- 5.] To make fast, secure: ἐπέδησε θύρας Od. 21.391.
ἐπιδημεύω [ἐπι- 2 + δῆμος in sense town. Cf. πανδήμιος.] To dwell or remain in the city Od. 16.28.

ἐπιδήμιος [ἐπι- 2 + δήμιος.] 1 Among one's people, at one's home Od. 1.194, 233. 2 Having a specified character in relation to one's own people as distinguished from strangers: ἐπιδήμιοι ἁρπακτῆρες (robbing your own folk (instead of your foes)) Il. 24.262. 3 Of war, civil: πολέμου Il. 9.64.

†ἐπιδίδωμι [ἐπι- 5, ἐπι- 8.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέδωκε Il. 9.148, 290. Aor. infin. ἐπιδοῦναι Il. 23.559. 1 pl. fut. mid. ἐπιδωσόμεθα (v.l. ἐπιβωσόμεθα) Il. 10.463. 1 pl. aor. subj. ἐπιδώμεθα Il. 22.254. 1 To give with (a daughter). With dat., [μείλια] θυγατρί Il. 9.148 = 290. 2 To give by way of making up to a person: ἄλλο Il. 23.559. 3 In mid., with reciprocal sense, of parties to an oath, to grant to each other the sanction of the gods as witnesses: θεοὺς ἐπιδώμεθα Il. 22.254. App. with a vague notion of mutually calling upon a god: Ἀθήνην Il. 10.463.

ἐπιδινέω [ἐπι- 5 11.] 1 To whirl round (in preparation for a throw): λᾶαν ἧκʼ ἐπιδινήσας Il. 7.269: = Od. 9.538. Cf. Il. 3.378, Il. 19.268. 2 To turn over, ponder, consider. In mid.: τόδε θυμὸς πόλλʼ ἐπιδινεῖται Od. 20.218. 3 In pass., of flying birds, to wheel towards each other: ἐπιδινηθέντε τιναξάσθην πτερά Od. 2.151.
ἐπιδιφριάς -άδος, ἡ [ἐπι- 1 + δίφρος.] App. = ἄντυξ 1: ἵπποι ἐξ ἐπιδιφριάδος ἱμᾶσι δέδεντο Il. 10.475.
ἐπιδίφριος [as ἐπιδιφριάς.] (Put) on a chariot: εἰς ὅ κε δῶρα ἐπιδίφρια θήῃ (θείω) Od. 15.51, 75.

data.quote: εἰς ὅ κε δῶρα ἐπιδίφρια θήῃ (θείω)

definition: ἐπιδόντα acc. sing. masc. aor. pple. ἐπείδω.
ἐπιδοῦναι aor. infin. ἐπιδίδωμι.
ἐπίδρομος [ἐπι- 11 + δρομ-, δραμ-. See τρέχω.] Capable of being taken by assault: τεῖχος Il. 6.434.
ἐπιδώμεθα 1 pl. aor. subj. mid. ἐπιδίδωμι.
ἐπιδωσόμεθα 1 pl. fut. mid. ἐπιδίδωμι.
ἔπιε 3 sing. aor. πίνω.
ἐπιείκελος [ἐπι- 19 + εἴκελος.] Like, resembleing. With dat.: ἀθανάτοισιν Il. 1.265, Il. 4.394, Il. 11.60. Cf. Il. 9.485, 494, Il. 22.279, Il. 23.80, Il. 24.486: Od. 15.414, Od. 21.14, 37, Od. 24.36.

ἐπιεικής [ἐπι- 19 + (ϝ)είκω1.] 1 Befitting, fitting, meet, suitable: τύμβον Il. 23.246. Adequate in amount or value: ἀμοιβήν Od. 12.382. 2 Absol. in neut. ἐπιεικές, what is fitting, meet, right: ἃς ἐ. ὀπυιέμεν ἐστίν Od. 2.207. With copula to be supplied: ὡς ἐ. Il. 8.431, Il. 19.147, Il. 23.537: Od. 8.389. So with infin.: ὅν κʼ ἐ. ἀκουέμεν Il. 1.547. Cf. Il. 19.21, Il. 23.50.

ἐπιεικτός -όν [app. ἐπι- 4 + (ϝ)είκω2. For the form cf. νεμεσητός 2.] Always with neg., giving senses 1 Unyielding, indomitable: μένος οὐκ ἐπιεικτόν Od. 19.493. 2 Ungovernable, not to be restrained: μένος Il. 5.892. 3 Irresistible: σθένος Il. 8.32. 4 Irrepressible: πένθος Il. 16.549. 5 Intolerable, unendurable: ἔργα Od. 8.307.
ἐπιείσομαι fut. mid. ἐφίημι2.
ἐπιέλπω [ἐπι- 19.] In mid., to hope. With fut. infin.: ἐμοὺς μύθους εἰδήσειν Il. 1.545. With acc. and fut. infin.: ἐπιελπόμενος τό γε θυμῷ νευρὴν ἐντανύειν Od. 21.126.

data.quote: ἐπιελπόμενος τό γε θυμῷ νευρὴν ἐντανύειν

definition: †ἐπιέννυμι [ἐπι- 12.] 1 pl. aor. ἐπιέσσαμεν Od. 20.143. Pf. pple. mid. ἐπιειμένος, -ου Il. 1.149, Il. 7.164, Il. 8.262, Il. 9.372, Il. 18.157: Od. 9.214, 514. 1 In act., to put upon a person as a (bed-) covering: χλαῖναν Od. 20.143. 2 In pf. mid. in sense sim. to those of ἕννυμι II.2. Fig.: ἀναιδείην ἐπιειμένε (clothed with . . . as with a garment) Il. 1.149, ἐπιειμένοι ἀλκήν (clad upon with . . .) Il. 7.164 = Il. 8.262, Il. 18.157. Cf. Il. 9.372: Od. 9.214, 514.
ἐπιέσσαμεν 1 pl. aor. ἐπιέννυμι.
ἐπιζάφελος [app. ἐπι- 19 + *ζάφελος in sim. sense, poss. fr. ζα- + φελ-, to swell. Cf. ὀφέλλω2.] Thus, of wrath, swelling, bursting forth, furious: χόλος Il. 9.525.
ἐπιζαφελῶς [adv. corresponding to ἐπιζάφελος. From *ἐπιζαφελής.] Furiously Il. 9.516: Od. 6.330.
ἐπίηλε 3 sing. aor. ἐπιάλλω.
ἐπιήρανος [ἐπι- 19 + (ϝ)ήρ. Cf. ἐρίηρος.] Pleasing, grateful: ποδάνιπτρα Od. 19.343.
ἐπιθαρσύνω [ἐπι- 5.] To cheer, encourage Il. 4.183.
ἐπιθεῖναι aor. infin. ἐπιτίθημι.
ἐπίθημα -ατος, τό [ἐπι- 1 + θη-, τίθημι.] A lid or cover: φωριαμῶν Il. 24.228.
ἐπιθήσω fut. ἐπιτίθημι.
ἐπίθοντο 3 pl. aor. mid. πείθω.
ἐπιθρέξαντος genit. sing. neut. aor. pple. ἐπιτρέχω.

ἐπιθρῴσκω [ἐπι- 12 14.] 1 To leap upon. With dat.: τύμβῳ μενελάου (in way of insult or derision) Il. 4.177. To leap on board of (a ship). With genit.: νηός Il. 8.515. 2 To leap or bound over (a space). With acc.: τόσσον ἐπιθρῴσκουσιν ἵπποι Il. 5.772.
ἐπιθύω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 11.] 1 To rush to or at something Od. 16.297. 2 With infin., to be eager, strive: [νέκυν] ἐρύσσασθαι Il. 18.175.

ἐπιίστωρ -ορος, ὁ [ἐπι- 5 + (ϝ)ισ-, οἶδα. See εἴδω C. One who has knowledge in a particular line.] Thus app., one with knowledge or experience of something specified: μεγάλων ἔργων (deeds of prowess) Od. 21.26.
ἐπικάρ also written ἐπὶ κάρ. App., either headlong (as fr. ἐπὶ κάρη (ἐπί II.2.d)) or (with obscure derivation) sideways: χαράδραι ῥέουσαι ἐ. Il. 16.392.
ἐπικάρσιος -η, -ον [ἐπικάρ.] Of ships, app., plunging their bows in the sea, or drifting side-ways, making leeway Od. 9.70.
ἐπίκειμαι [ἐπι- 12 18.] 3 sing. fut. ἐπικείσεται Il. 6.458. 1 To be laid or imposed upon a person: ἐπικείσετʼ ἀνάγκη Il. 6.458. 2 Of a door, to be shut: θύραι ἐπέκειντο Od. 6.19.
†ἐπικείρω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέκερσε. App., to cut the line of retreat of, cut off the retreat of Il. 16.394.
ἐπικείσεται fut. ἐπίκειμαι.
ἐπικεκλιμένας acc. pl. fem. pf. pple. pass. ἐπικλίνω.

†ἐπικέλλω [ἐπι- 12.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέκελσε Od. 13.114. Infin. ἐπικέλσαι Od. 9.148. Acc. pl. masc. pple. ἐπικέλσαντας Od. 9.138. 1 To put one's ship on shore, bring her to shore Od. 9.138. 2 Of a ship, to come to shore Od. 9.148. To come to shore on. With dat.: ἠπείρῳ Od. 13.114.
†ἐπικέλομαι [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπεκέκλετο. To call upon, summon, invoke: Ἐρινῦς (i.e. to further his prayers) Il. 9.454.
ἐπικεράννυμι [ἐπι- 5.] Aor. infin. ἐπικρῆσαι. To mix (wine) with water Od. 7.164.

ἐπικερτομέω [ἐπι- 5.] To make fun of, mock, jeer at Il. 16.744: Od. 22.194. In Il. 24.649 ἐπικερτομέων is app. to be taken as absol., and as referring to Achilles' tone in what follows as to Agamemnon.

ἐπικεύθω [ἐπι- 5.] Fut. ἐπικεύσω Il. 5.816, Il. 10.115: Od. 4.350, 744, Od. 5.143, Od. 14.467, Od. 17.141, 154, Od. 19.269, Od. 23.265. 2 sing. aor. subj. ἐπικεύσῃς Od. 15.263. 1 To withhold (speech) Il. 5.816: Od. 4.350 = Od. 17.141, Od. 4.744, Od. 16.168, Od. 18.171. 2 Absol., to conceal one's thoughts or knowledge, withhold speech Il. 10.115: Od. 5.143, Od. 14.467, Od. 15.263, Od. 17.154, Od. 19.269, Od. 23.265.
ἐπικίδνημι [ἐπι- 15.] In pass., of the water of a river, to be spread over, to flow upon. With acc.: αἶαν Il. 2.850. So of the dawn, to be spread or shed over (a space) Il. 7.451, 458.
ἐπικλείω [ἐπι- 5.] To praise, extol, applaud; ἀοιδήν Od. 1.351.

ἐπίκλησις ἡ [ἐπι- 6 + κλη-, καλέω.] 1 In acc. with a vb. of naming, as a second or derived name: ὅν τε κύνʼ Ὠρίωνος ἐπίκλησιν καλέουσιν Il. 22.29, Ἀστυάναξ, ὃν Τρῶες ἐπίκλησιν καλέουσιν (i.e. name thus) 506 (cf. Il. 6.402). Cf. Il. 7.138 (as a nickname), Il. 18.487: = Od. 5.273. 2 Adverbially in acc., in name, nominally (cf. πρόφασις, χάρις 2.b): ἐπίκλησιν βώρῳ [τέκεν] Il. 16.177.

data.quote: ὅν τε κύνʼ Ὠρίωνος ἐπίκλησιν καλέουσιν

definition: †ἐπικλίνω [ἐπι- 18.] Acc. pl. fem. pf. pple. pass. ἐπικεκλιμένας. To put into position for closing a gate, put to: ἐπικεκλιμένας σανίδας καὶ ὀχῆα Il. 12.121.

ἐπίκλοπος ὁ [ἐπι- 5 + κλοπ-, κλέπτω.] 1 Cunning, wily Od. 13.291. 2 With genit., using deceit in the matter of, cunning or wily in: μύθων Il. 22.281. Cunning or skilful in the matter of: τόξων Od. 21.397. 3 As sb., a cozener or cheat Od. 11.364.
ἐπίκλυον aor. [ἐπι- 5.] 1 To listen to, give ear to: ἐπεὶ αἶνον ἐπέκλυεν Il. 23.652. 2 To hear, learn. With genit.: Ζηνὸς ἀγγελιάων Od. 5.150.

†ἐπικλώθω [ἐπι- 5 + κλώθω, to spin. Cf. κλῶθες. To spin the thread of one's destiny] (Cf. ἐπινέω.) 3 sing. aor. ἐπέκλωσε Od. 16.64. 3 pl. -αν Od. 3.208, Od. 11.139. 3 sing. subj. ἐπικλώσῃ Od. 4.208. 3 pl. aor. mid. ἐπεκλώσαντο Il. 24.525: Od. 1.17, Od. 8.579. 3 pl. subj. ἐπικλώσωνται Od. 20.196. To assign as one's lot or portion: ὄλβον Od. 3.208, Od. 4.208, τά Od. 11.139, Od. 16.64. In mid. Od. 8.579, Od. 20.196. With infin. In mid.: οἶκόνδε νέεσθαι Od. 1.17. Absol. In mid. Il. 24.525.
†ἐπικόπτω [ἐπι- 5.] Fut. pple. ἐπικόψων. To bring one's blow to bear upon, strike: βοῦν Od. 3.443.
ἐπικουρέω [ἐπίκουρος.] To give one's services in aid, fight in another's cause Il. 5.614.

ἐπίκουρος -ου, ὁ [no doubt a compound of ἐπι-.] 1 One who gives his services in aid, one who fights in support of another or in another's cause Il. 3.188, Il. 5.478, Il. 21.431. 2 In pl., auxiliaries Il. 4.379. Esp. of the allies supporting the Trojan cause Il. 2.130, 803, 815, Il. 3.451, 456, Il. 5.473, etc.
ἐπικόψων fut. pple. ἐπικόπτω.

ἐπικραίνω ἐπικραιαίνω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ἐπικρήνειε Il. 15.599. Imp. ἐπικρήηνον Il. 1.455, Il. 8.242, Il. 16.238. To grant accomplishment or fulfilment of (a wish or prayer) Il. 1.455 = Il. 16.238, Il. 8.242, Il. 15.599. Absol. Il. 2.419, Il. 3.302.

ἐπικρατέω [ἐπι- 5.] 1 To hold rule: ὅτʼ ἐπικρατέωσιν ἄνακτες οἱ νέοι Od. 14.60 (as ἄνακτες (masters), i.e. when the young are masters). To give directions, keep one's rule in evidence Od. 17.320. 2 With dat., to hold sway among or in: νήεσσιν Il. 10.214: νήσοισιν Od. 1.245 = Od. 16.122 = Od. 19.130. 3 To have the upper hand in battle, be victorious Il. 14.98.
ἐπικρατέως [adv. fr. ἐπικρατής conn. with ἐπικρατέω.] In overwhelming force, with over-powering might Il. 16.67, 81. Putting forth one's strength: ἰὸν ἧκεν ἐ. Il. 23.863.
ἐπικρήηνον aor. imp. ἐπικραίνω.
ἐπικρήνειε 3 sing. aor. opt. ἐπικραίνω.
ἐπικρῆσαι aor. infin. ἐπικεράννυμι.
ἐπίκριον τό [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1 + ἴκρια.] A top or look-out place fitted to the mast at some distance above its base in the ἴκρια Od. 5.254, 318.
†ἐπιλάμπω [ἐπι- 4.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέλαμψε. To shine or give its light on the occurrence of something specified: ἠέλιος ἐπέλαμψεν (there-upon) Il. 17.650.
ἐπιλείβω [ἐπι- 12.] To make a libation upon something specified: ἀνιστάμενοι ἐπέλειβον Od. 3.341.
ἐπιλεύσσω [ἐπι- 14.] To see, have vision, over (a space). With acc.: τόσσον ἐπιλεύσσει Il. 3.12.
ἐπίληθος [ἐπιλήθω.] Bringing forgetfulness. With genit.: φάρμακον κακῶν ἐπίληθον Od. 4.221.

ἐπιλήθω [ἐπι- 19.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέλησε Od. 20.85. Fut. mid. ἐπιλήσομαι Il. 22.387. 3 sing. -εται Od. 1.57. 3 pl. -ονται Il. 7.452. 1 In act., to cause to forget. With genit.: ἁπάντων Od. 20.85. 2 In mid., with genit. a To forget, cease to think of: τείχεος τὸ πολίσσαμεν Il. 7.452. Cf. Il. 22.387: Od. 1.57. b To forget, fail to bethink or avail oneself of: τέχνης Od. 4.455, σχεδίης Od. 5.324.
ἐπιληκέω [ἐπι- 8 + ληκ-, λάσκω. To make a sound in accompaniment.] Hence, app., to beat time with the feet Od. 8.379.
ἐπιλήσομαι fut. mid. ἐπιλήθω.
ἐπιλίγδην [ἐπι- 19 + λίγδην.] In a grazing manner, so as to be wounded superficially Il. 17.599.
ἐπιλλίζω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 + ἰλλίζω, conn. with ἰλλός, squinting.] To make a sidelong glance at in order to incite to something. With dat.: ἐπιλλίζουσί μοι ἑλκέμεναι δὲ κέλονται Od. 18.11.
ἐπιλωβεύω [ἐπι- 5.] To mock at a person Od. 2.323.
†ἐπιμαίνομαι [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπεμήνατο. To be mad after. With dat.: βελλεροφόντῃ Il. 6.160.

ἐπιμαίομαι [ἐπι- 5 11.] 3 sing. fut. ἐπιμάσσεται Il. 4.190. 3 sing. aor. ἐπεμάσσατο Od. 13.429, Od. 16.172. Pple. ἐπιμασσάμενος Od. 9.302, 446, Od. 19.480. Fem. -η Od. 19.468. 1 With genit., to aim at, seek to get: μεγάλων δώρων Il. 10.401. To strive after, struggle for: νόστου Od. 5.344. To steer for, head for: σκοπέλου Od. 12.220. 2 To strike: μάστιγι ἵππους Il. 5.748 = Il. 8.392. Cf. Il. 17.430: Od. 13.429, Od. 16.172. 3 To seize, grasp Od. 19.480. 4 To handle, touch, feel: ὀΐων νῶτα Od. 9.441. Cf. Od. 9.446. Absol. Od. 9.302 (feeling for the mortal spot), Od. 19.468. To keep feeling, finger; ξίφεος κώπην Od. 11.531. To put the hand upon, examine (a wound) Il. 4.190.
ἐπιμάρτυρος ὁ [ἐπι- 5 + μάρτυρος.] (Written also as two words.) A witness invoked in sanction of something: Ζεὺς ἄμμʼ ἐ. ἔστω Il. 7.76. Cf. Od. 1.273.
ἐπιμάσσεται 3 sing. fut. ἐπιμαίομαι.
ἐπίμαστος [ἐπιμασ-, ἐπιμαίομαι.] App., sought out, that has been brought (i.e. by Eumaeus), and has not come unasked: ἀλήτην Od. 20.377.
ἐπιμειδάω [ἐπι- 5.] To smile at a person, look towards him with a smile of propitiation or encouragement Il. 4.356, Il. 8.38: Od. 22.371. With a smile of amusement or derision Il. 10.400.
ἐπιμεῖναι aor. infin. ἐπιμένω.

ἐπιμέμφομαι [ἐπι- 5 + μέμφομαι in sim. sense] To find fault, show displeasure: εὐχωλῆς (in the matter of . . .) Il. 1.65, 93, τέο ἐπιμέμφεαι; Il. 2.225. To find fault with, blame. With dat.: κασιγνήτοις Od. 16.97, 115.

†ἐπιμένω [ἐπι- 6 19.] Aor. imp. ἐπίμεινον Il. 6.340, Il. 19.142: Od. 1.309, Od. 4.587, Od. 17.277. Infin. ἐπιμεῖναι Od. 11.351. 1 To wait or tarry (a little) longer: νῦν ἐπίμεινον Il. 6.340. Cf. Il. 19.142: Od. 1.309, Od. 4.587, Od. 11.351. 2 To remain where one is, stay behind Od. 17.277.
ἐπιμήδομαι [ἐπι- 5.] To contrive (something) against. With dat.: δόλον ἐπεμήδετο πατρί Od. 4.437.
ἐπιμηνίω [ἐπι- 5.] To cherish resentment against. With dat.: Πριάμῳ Il. 13.460.

ἐπιμιμνήσκομαι [ἐπι- 5.] 1 pl. aor. opt. mid. ἐπιμνησαίμεθα Il. 17.103: Od. 4.191. Aor. pple. pass. ἐπιμνησθείς Od. 1.31, Od. 4.189. With genit. 1 In mid. and pass., to remember, think of : Αἰγίσθοιο Od. 1.31. Cf. Od. 4.189. To remember, bethink oneself of: χάρμης Il. 17.103. 2 In mid., to speak about: σεῖο Od. 4.191.
ἐπιμίμνω [ἐπι- 2.] To remain or abide at. With dat.: ἔργον ᾧ ἐπιμίμνω Od. 14.66, Od. 15.372.

ἐπιμίξ [ἐπι- 19 + μιξ-, μίσγω.] Mingled together, in a confused mass: πλῆτο ἐ. ἵππων τε καὶ ἀνδρῶν Il. 21.16. Cf. Il. 23.242. In confusion, with all order lost: ὀρίνονται Il. 11.525. Cf. Il. 14.60. Indiscriminately, with random rage: μαίνεται Od. 11.537.

data.quote: πλῆτο ἐ. ἵππων τε καὶ ἀνδρῶν

definition: ἐπιμίσγω [ἐπι- 5.] In pass. with dat.,, to mingle with, have dealings or intercourse with: ἄμμι Od. 6.205. Cf. Od. 6.241. In hostile sense: ἂψ ἐπιμισγομένων (as they joined battle (app. genit. absolute and referring to the whole of the combatants)) Il. 5.505, αἰεὶ Τρώεσσʼ ἐπιμίσγομαι (am always in touch with . . .) Il. 10.548.
ἐπιμνησαίμεθα 1 pl. aor. opt. mid. ἐπιμιμνήσκω.
ἐπιμνησθείς aor. pple. pass. ἐπιμιμνήσκω.
†ἐπιμύζω [ἐπι- 4 + μύζω, to murmur.] 3 pl. aor. ἐπέμυξαν. To murmur or mutter at something: ἐπέμυξαν Ἀθηναίη τε καὶ Ἥρη (thereat) Il. 4.20 = Il. 8.457.
†ἐπινέμω [ἐπι- 14.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπένειμε. To distribute or give out among a company: σῖτον Il. 9.216, Il. 24.625: Od. 20.254.
ἐπινεύω [ἐπι- 5.] To nod: κόρυθι δʼ ἐπένευεν (with his . . ., i.e. it nodded) Il. 22.314. To nod in sanction of a promise Il. 15.75.
ἐπινεφρίδιος [ἐπι- 1 + νεφρός, the kidneys.] On forming part of the substance of, the kidneys: δημόν Il. 21.204.
ἐπινέω [ἐπι- 5 + νέω2.] (Cf. ἐπικλώθω.) To assign as one's lot or portion Il. 20.128. Absol. with complementary infin.: τῷ ὣς μοῖρʼ ἐπένησε . . . κύνας ἆσαι Il. 24.210.

data.quote: τῷ ὣς μοῖρʼ ἐπένησε . . . κύνας ἆσαι

definition: ἐπινηνέω [ἐπι- 12 + νηνέω, app. = νηέω.] To pile or heap up upon. With genit.: νεκροὺς πυρκαϊῆς Il. 7.428 = 431.
ἐπίξυνος -ον [ἐπι- 19 + ξυνός.] Common: ἀρούρῃ Il. 12.422.
ἔπιον aor. πίνω.
ἐπιόντα acc. sing. masc. pple. ἔπειμι2.
ἐπιορκέω [ἐπίορκος.] To swear falsely, perjure oneself: οὐδʼ ἐπιορκήσω Il. 19.188.

ἐπίορκος [app. ἐπι- 5 + ὅρκος. In violation of one's oath.] 1 Falsely sworn Il. 19.264. 2 In neut. ἐπίορκον as adv., of swearing, falsely, so as to perjure oneself: ὅτις κʼ ἐ. ὀμόσσῃ Il. 3.279, Il. 19.260, ἐ. ἐπώμοσεν Il. 10.332 (here of unintentional falsity, the fulfiment of the oath turning out to be impossible).
ἐπιόσσομαι [ἐπι- 5.] To have one's eye upon; hence, to exercise vigilance, use one's efforts, to prevent: ἐπιοσσομένω θάνατον ἑταίρων Il. 17.381.
ἐπίουρος [ἐπι- 10 + οὖρος2. Cf. ἐπιβουκόλος.] 1 A guardian, protector, warder Il. 13.450. 2 A herdsman Od. 13.405 = Od. 15.39.
ἐπιόψομαι fut. See ἐφοράω.

ἐπιπείθω [ἐπι- 4.] Fut. mid. ἐπιπείσομαι Il. 23.609. 2 sing. -εαι Il. 15.178. 3 sing. -εται Il. 15.162, Il. 17.154, Il. 18.296. In mid., to yield to inducement, persuasion or command, to do another's bidding, be ruled, obey: οὔ τις ἐπιπείσεται Il. 18.296. Cf. Il. 9.660: Od. 2.103 = Od. 10.466 = Od. 12.28 = Od. 24.138, Od. 10.406, 475, 550 = Od. 12.321 = Od. 19.148. With dat.: σοὶ ἐπιπείθονται Il. 5.878. Cf. Il. 1.218, 345 = Il. 9.205 = Il. 11.616, Il. 1.565, Il. 4.412, Il. 15.162, 178, Il. 19.305, Il. 23.609: Od. 19.14 = Od. 22.108 = 393. With infin. Il. 17.154 (see under εἶμι 1.a).
†ἐπιπέλομαι [ἐπι- 11.] Neut. aor. pple. ἐπιπλόμενον. Of time, to come on or round: ἐπιπλόμενον ἔτος (the pple. adjectivally, revolving) Od. 7.261 = Od. 14.287.

†ἐπιπέτομαι [ἐπι- 11.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέπτατο Il. 13.821: Od. 15.160, 525. Aor. infin. ἐπιπτέσθαι Il. 4.126. To fly towards. With dat.: εἰπόντι οἱ ἐπέπτατο ὄρνις Il. 13.821: = Od. 15.160 = 525. Of an arrow, to fly or speed to its mark Il. 4.126.
ἐπιπίλναμαι [ἐπι- 11.] To approach or come near to a specified place: οὐ χιὼν ἐπιπίλναται Od. 6.44.
†ἐπιπλάζω [ἐπι- 14.] Aor. pple. pass. ἐπιπλαγχθείς. In pass., to wander or rove over or upon. With acc.: πόντον ἐπιπλαγχθείς Od. 8.14.

ἐπιπλέω [ἐπι- 14.] Also ἐπιπλώω Od. 5.284. Aor. pple. ἐπιπλώσας Il. 3.47. 2 sing. aor. ἐπέπλως Od. 3.15. Pple. ἐπιπλώς Il. 6.291. To sail over or upon, traverse. With acc.: πόντον ἐπιπλώσας Il. 3.47. Cf. Il. 1.312, Il. 6.291: Od. 3.15, Od. 4.842, Od. 5.284, Od. 9.227, 470, Od. 15.474.
ἐπιπλήσσω [ἐπι- 5.] Fut. infin. ἐπιπλήξειν Il. 23.580. 1 To strike Il. 10.500. 2 To attack with words, to find fault with, chide. With dat.: μοι Il. 12.211, Il. 23.580.
ἐπιπλόμενον neut. aor. pple. ἐπιπέλομαι.
ἐπιπλώς aor. pple. ἐπιπλέω.
ἐπιπλώω See ἐπιπλέω.

ἐπιπνέω [ἐπι- 5.] In pres. only in forms fr. ἐπιπνείω. 3 pl. aor. subj. ἐπιπνεύσωσι Od. 9.139. Of wind 1 To blow upon a person Il. 5.698. To blow upon. With dat.: νηΐ Od. 4.357. 2 To blow in a particular (i.e. the desired) direction Od. 9.139.
ἐπιποιμήν -ένος [ἐπι- 10 + ποιμήν. Cf. ἐπιβουκόλος.] A herdsman Od. 12.131.
ἐπιπρέπω [ἐπι- 19.] To have a specified appearance: οὐδέ τοι δούλειον ἐπιπρέπει εἶδος (shows like a slave's) Od. 24.252.
ἐπιπροέηκα aor. ἐπιπροΐημι.
ἐπιπροέμεν aor. infin. ἐπιπροΐημι.
†ἐπιπροϊάλλω [ἐπι- 11 + προ- 1.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπιπροΐηλε. To push forward towards (and for) a person: τράπεζάν σφωϊν Il. 11.628.

†ἐπιπροΐημι [ἐπι- 11 + προ- 1 + ἵημι1.] Aor. ἐπιπροέηκα Il. 17.708, Il. 18.58, 439. 3 sing. ἐπιπροέηκε Il. 9.520: Od. 15.299. Aor. infin. ἐπιπροέμεν Il. 4.94. 1 To send forth or let fly (an arrow) at. With dat.: Μενελάῳ ἰόν Il. 4.94. 2 To send forth (a person) on a specified or indicated mission: ἄνδρας Il. 9.520, Ἀχιλλῆα νηυσίν Il. 18.58 = Il. 18.439 (the dat. appears to be sociative, with the . . .). 3 To send forth (a person) towards or to. With dat.: κεῖνον νηυσίν Il. 17.708. 4 To steer for, make for. With dat.: νήσοισιν Od. 15.299.

data.ref: Il. 18.439 (the dat. appears to be sociative,

definition: †ἐπιπταίρω [ἐπι- 4.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέπταρε. To sneeze at, i.e. as giving a favourable omen to accompany. With dat.: πᾶσι ἔπεσσιν Od. 17.545.
ἐπιπτέσθαι aor. infin. ἐπιπέτομαι.

ἐπιπωλέομαι [ἐπι- 14.] 1 To go round or among, inspect, review. With acc.: στίχας ἀνδρῶν Il. 3.196, Il. 4.231, 250. 2 To range round or among with hostile intent. With acc.: στίχας ἀνδρῶν Il. 11.264 = 540.
†ἐπιρρέζω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 pl. pa. iterative ἐπιρρέζεσκον. To do sacrifice to an indicated divinity Od. 17.211.
ἐπιρρέπω [ἐπι- 5.] To descend in the scales of fate upon, come upon. With dat.: ὄφρʼ ἡμῖν ὄλεθρος ἐπιρρέπῃ Il. 14.99.
ἐπιρρέω [ἐπι- 12.] 1 To flow over or on the surface of. With acc.: πηνειόν Il. 2.754. 2 Fig., of bodies of men, to stream on and on Il. 11.724.
†ἐπιρρήσσω [ἐπι- 18.] 3 sing. pa. iterative ἐπιρρήσσεσκε Il. 24.456. 3 pl. -ον Il. 24.454. To thrust or drive home (the fastening of a gate): ἐπιβλῆτα Il. 24.454, 456.
†ἐπιρρίπτω [ἐπι- 11] 3 pl. aor. ἐπέρριψαν. To throw or hurl at. With dat.: δοῦρά μοι Od. 5.310.
ἐπίρροθος [ἐπιρροθέω, to shout to (in encouragement), fr. ἐπι- 5 + ῥοθέω to make a sound. Cf. ῥόθιος.] A supporter, aider, helper Il. 4.390, Il. 23.770.

ἐπιρρώομαι [ἐπι- 2, ἐπι- 4.] 3 pl. aor. ἐπερρώσαντο Il. 1.529. 1 Of hair, to ripple or flow forward on the occurrence of something: νεῦσε . . . χαῖται δʼ ἐπερρώσαντο (with the nod) Il. 1.529. 2 To ply one's task at. With dat.: μύλαισιν Od. 20.107.

ἐπίσκοπος -ου, ὁ [ἐπι- 5 + σκοπ-, σκέπτομαι.] 1 One who watches over something, a guardian or protector Il. 22.255, Il. 24.729. One who looks (sharply) after something, a (keen) trafficker in or snatcher of something: ὁδαίων Od. 8.163. 2 One who spies upon (something), a spy. With dat.: Τρώεσσιν Il. 10.38, νήεσσιν 342.
ἐπισκύζομαι [ἐπι- 4.] 3 sing. aor. opt. ἐπισκύσσαιτο Od. 7.306. To be angry or offended at something Il. 9.370: Od. 7.306 (should take offence).
ἐπισκύνιον τό [no doubt a compound of ἐπι-.] The fold of skin above the eyes. Of a lion Il. 17.136.
ἐπισκύσσαιτο 3 sing. aor. opt. ἐπισκύζομαι.
ἐπισμυγερῶς [adv. fr. ἐπισμυγερός, fr. ἐπι- 19 + σμυγερός app. = μογερός, adj. fr. μόγος.] In sad or grievous fashion, to one's cost Od. 3.195, Od. 4.672.
ἐπίσπαστος [ἐπισπασ-, ἐπισπάω, fr. ἐπι- 5 + σπάω.] Brought upon oneself, such as one has oneself to thank for: κακόν Od. 18.73, Od. 24.462.
ἐπισπεῖν aor. infin. ἐφέπω1.
ἐπισπέρχω [ἐπι- 5.] 1 To urge a person or a horse on to exertion Od. 23.430: Od. 22.451. 2 Intrans. for reflexive, of wind, to rush, blow furiously Od. 5.304.
ἐπισπέσθαι aor. infin. mid. ἐφέπω2.
ἐπισσείω [ἐπι- 5.] 1 To shake something (threateningly) at a person: τῇ (sc. αἰγίδι) ἐπισσείων φοβέειν Ἀχαιούς Il. 15.230 (τῇ with φοβέειν). 2 To shake (thus) at. With dat.: αἰγίδα πᾶσιν Il. 4.167.

ἐπισσεύω [ἐπι- 5 11.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέσσευε Od. 18.256, Od. 19.129, Od. 20.87. 3 sing. subj. ἐπισσεύῃ Od. 5.421. Pple. ἐπισσεύας Od. 14.399. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπέσσυτο Il. 5.438, 459, Il. 9.398, Il. 21.227, etc.: Od. 4.841, Od. 6.20. 1 pl. ἐπεσσύμεθα Od. 4.454. 3 sing. pf. ἐπέσσυται Il. 1.173, Il. 6.361, Il. 9.42. Pple. ἐπεσσύμενος, -ου Il. 12.143, 388, Il. 14.147, Il. 15.395, Il. 16.411, 511, Il. 17.737, Il. 20.288, Il. 22.26: Od. 5.314, 428, 431, Od. 22.307, 310. I 1 To set on or incite against a person Od. 14.399. 2 With dat., to set in motion or send against: κῆτός μοι Od. 5.421. To send or cause to operate against: κακά μοι Od. 18.256 = Od. 19.129. Cf. Od. 20.87. II In mid. 1 To hasten or speed towards a specified or indicated point: ἀγορήνδʼ ἐπεσσεύοντο Il. 2.208, ἐπεσσύμενον πεδίοιο (over the . . .) Il. 22.26. Cf. Il. 2.86, Il. 13.757, Il. 18.575: Od. 13.19. 2 To speed to. With dat.: οἱ Od. 4.841. With acc.: δέμνια κούρης Od. 6.20. 3 In hostile sense, to rush, dart, dash, spring at or against someone or something: ἐπέσσυτο δαίμονι ἶσος Il. 5.438 = Il. 16.705 = 786 = Il. 20.447. Cf. Il. 16.411, Il. 20.288, Il. 21.234, 601: Od. 4.454. Of a wave Od. 5.314, 431. 4 To do this against. With dat.: νηυσίν Il. 15.347, 593. Cf. Il. 5.459 = 884, Il. 21.227. With acc.: μνηστῆρας Od. 22.307. Cf. Il. 12.143, Il. 15.395. Of fire Il. 17.737. With genit.: τείχεος Il. 12.388, Il. 16.511. 5 Without indication of direction, to speed, rush: ἐπεσσύμενος πεδίοιο Il. 14.147. 6 In pf. pple., putting forth an effort, making a spring: ἐπεσσύμενος λάβε πέτρης Od. 5.428. Speeding, running up: λάβε γούνων Od. 22.310. 7 To be set, bent, disposed, inclined in an indicated direction: εἴ τοι θυμὸς ἐπέσσυται Il. 1.173. With complementary infin.: κτήμασι τέρπεσθαι Il. 9.398. With ὥς τε and infin.: ὥς τε νέεσθαι Il. 9.42. With ὄφρα Il. 6.361.
ἐπίσσωτρον [ἐπι- 1 + σῶτρον, felloe.] The tire of a wheel Il. 5.725, Il. 11.537, Il. 20.394, 502, Il. 23.505, 519.

ἐπισταδόν [ἐπι- 14 + στα-, ἵστημι.] Going round and standing or stopping by each in turn: νείκεον Od. 12.392. Cf. Od. 13.54 = Od. 18.425. Attending to each detail in succession: δόρπον ὁπλίζοντο Od. 16.453.

ἐπίσταμαι 3 sing. subj. ἐπίστηται Il. 16.243. 3 sing. opt. ἐπίσταιτο Il. 14.92: Od. 8.240. 1 pl. -αίμεσθα Il. 13.238. 3 pl. fut. ἐπιστήσονται Il. 21.320. 1 With infin. a To know how to do, have skill, be skilled, in doing: δαίδαλα τεύχειν Il. 5.60, ἢ ἐπίστηται πολεμίζειν (will prove to be a fighter) Il. 16.243. Cf. Il. 2.611, Il. 5.222 = Il. 8.106, Il. 13.223, 238: Od. 9.49. b To be able to do (something difficult or puzzling): ὀστέʼ ἀλλέξαι Il. 21.320. With neg., to be at a loss as to doing: οὔ πῃ θέσθαι ἐπίσταμαι Od. 13.207. To have the strength to do: πῆλαι ἔγχος Il. 16.142 = Il. 19.389. c To know how to do, have the wit, knowledge, character, turn of mind, needed for doing: ἄρτια βάζειν Il. 14.92: = Od. 8.240. Cf. Il. 17.671, Il. 4.404. 2 To know so as to have skill in: ἔργα Il. 23.705: Od. 2.117 = Od. 7.111. 3 Adjectivally in pres. pple. a Skilled, skilful, expert, clever, astute: ἐπιστάμενος ἄκοντι (comitative dat., with the . . .) Il. 15.282. Cf. Il. 19.80: ἰητρὸς ἐπιστάμενος Od. 4.231. Cf. Od. 13.313, Od. 23.185. So ἐπισταμένοισι πόδεσσιν Il. 18.599. b Skilled in or in the use of. With genit.: φόρμιγγος καὶ ἀοιδῆς Od. 21.406. c In moral sense, knowing the right, of good character or disposition Od. 14.359. 4 Absol., to know, have knowledge: ἐπιστάμεναι σάφα θυμῷ Od. 4.730.

ἐπισταμένως [adv. fr. pres. pple. of ἐπίσταμαι.] Skilfully, deftly, dexterously: μίστυλλον Il. 7.317 = Il. 24.623, ὀδόντες ἔχον ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ἐ. (skilfully arranged or disposed) Il. 10.265. Cf. Od. 5.25, 245, Od. 11.368, Od. 12.307, Od. 17.341 = Od. 21.44, Od. 19.422, 457, Od. 20.159, 161, Od. 23.197.

data.quote: ὀδόντες ἔχον ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ἐ.

definition: ἐπιστάτης ὁ [ἐπι- 2 + στα-, ἵστημι. One who stands by or beside.] A suppliant or almsman; or perh., a follower or dependant Od. 17.455.
ἐπιστενάχω [ἐπι- 9.] To groan in answer. In mid.: ἐπεστενάχοντο δʼ ἑταῖροι Il. 4.154.
ἐπιστεφής [ἐπιστέφω.] Filled to the brim: κρητῆρας ἐπιστεφέας οἴνοιο (for the genit. cf. next) Il. 8.232: Od. 2.431.

†ἐπιστέφω [ἐπι- 5 + στέφω in sense to pack close.] 3 pl. aor. mid. ἐπεστέψαντο. To fill to the brim: κρητῆρας ἐπεστέψαντο ποτοῖο (genit. of material, with . . .) Il. 1.470, Il. 9.175: = Od. 1.148 = Od. 3.339 = Od. 21.271.
ἐπιστήμων [ἐπίσταμαι.] Skilful, clever, adroit: ἐ. βουλῇ τε νόῳ τε Od. 16.374.
ἐπιστήσονται 3 pl. fut. ἐπίσταμαι.
ἐπίστιον τό. A slip on which to haul up a ship Od. 6.265.
ἐπιστοναχέω [ἐπι- 4.] To make a sound under stress of something. Of the sea Il. 24.79.
†ἐπιστρέφω [ἐπι- 11.] Aor. pple. ἐπιστρέψας. Intrans. for reflexive, to turn oneself towards something: ἕλκεν ἐπιστρέψας Il. 3.370 (i.e. in pulling he turned partly round towards his friends).
ἐπιστροφάδην [as ἐπίστροφος.] Turning from one to another, taking one after another: κτεῖνεν Il. 10.483. Cf. Il. 21.20: Od. 22.308, Od. 24.184.
ἐπίστροφος [ἐπι- 14 + στροφ-, στρέφω.] Going about or among: ἐ. ἦν ἀνθρώπων (had intercourse or dealings with (many) men) Od. 1.177.
ἐπιστρωφάω [ἐπι- 14.] To go about among, visit. With acc.: ἐπιστρωφῶσι πόληας Od. 17.486.

ἐπισφύριον τό [ἐπι- 1 + σφυρόν.] Perh. a guard of metal fixed on the leg between the knee and the ankle and partly covering the κνημίς so as to supplement this in protecting against the chafing of the shield: κνημῖδας ἀργυρέοισιν ἐπισφυρίοις ἀραρυίας Il. 3.331 = Il. 11.18 = Il. 16.132 = Il. 19.370. Cf. Il. 18.459.
ἐπισχερώ [ἐπι- 7 + σχε- = (σ)εχ-, ἔχω.] In a row, one after or beside another: εἰς ὅ κε κτεινώμεθʼ ἐ. Il. 11.668, ἀκτὴν ἐσανέβαινον ἐ. Il. 18.68. Cf. Il. 23.125.
ἐπισχεσίη -ης, ἡ [ἐπι- 11 + σχε-. See ἐπισχερώ. Cf. ἐπέχω 3.] An offering or putting forward: μύθου Od. 21.71.
ἐπίσχεσις ἡ [ἐπι- 5 + σχε- as ἐπισχεσίη. Cf. ἐπέχω 6.] Holding back, reluctance, hesitation Od. 17.451.
ἐπισχοίης 2 sing. aor. opt. ἐπέχω.

ἐπίσχω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5 11.] 1 To aim or direct a missile in an indicated direction. In mid.: ἐπισχόμενος βάλεν ἰῷ Od. 22.15. 2 To restrain, control, manage: ἵππους Il. 17.465. To withhold or restrain from. With genit.: θυμὸν ἐνιπῆς Od. 20.266.
ἐπισχών aor. pple. ἐπέχω.
ἐπιτάρροθος [an unexplained word. App. conn. with ἐπίρροθος.] In sense = ἐπίρροθος Il. 5.808, 828, Il. 11.366 = Il. 20.453, Il. 12.180, Il. 17.339, Il. 21.289: Od. 24.182.

ἐπιτέλλω [ἐπι- 5.] 2 sing. aor. ἐπέτειλας Il. 5.818. Subj. ἐπιτείλω Il. 10.63, Il. 13.753. Imp. ἐπίτειλον Il. 24.112. Pple. ἐπιτείλας Il. 10.72, Il. 13.213. Infin. ἐπιτεῖλαι Il. 4.64, Il. 10.56. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπετείλατο Od. 1.327. Dat. sing. masc. pple. ἐπιτειλαμένῳ Od. 17.21. 1 To lay, impose, inflict upon a person. In mid.: νόστον λυγρόν, ὃν ἐπετείλατο Od. 1.327. With dat.: χαλεπούς μοι ἐπετέλλετʼ ἀέθλους Od. 11.622. 2 a To lay an injunction or charge upon, give an order or orders to, a person: ὣς ἐπέτελλεν Il. 9.259 = Il. 11.790. Cf. Il. 2.10, Il. 9.369, Il. 10.56, 72, Il. 11.768, 782, Il. 17.360, Il. 21.445: Od. 17.186. In mid. Il. 17.382: Od. 17.21. b With dat.: υἱέϊ σῷ Il. 24.112, ὧδέ μʼ ἐπέτελλε, μὴ . . . Il. 24.780 (with the assurance) that he would not...), cf. Il. 5.198, Il. 10.63, Il. 11.765, Il. 13.213, 753: Od. 17.9. In mid. Il. 2.802, Il. 4.301, Il. 10.61: Od. 12.217. c With dat. and the injunction directly reported Il. 11.785, Il. 17.668. In mid. Il. 9.252, Il. 16.838. d With acc. of what is enjoined or ordered: συνθεσιάων ἃς ἐπέτελλε (which he bade him remember) Il. 5.320. Cf. Il. 5.818. e With dat. and acc.: ἕκαστά μʼ ἐπέτελλεν Il. 23.107. Cf. Od. 23.361. In mid.: κούροισι ταῦτʼ ἐπιτέλλομαι Il. 9.68. Cf. Il. 1.295, Il. 19.192, Il. 23.95: Od. 8.40. f With dat. and infin.: Ἀθηναίῃ ἐπιτεῖλαι ἐλθεῖν Il. 4.64. Cf. Il. 4.229, Il. 6.207, Il. 9.179, Il. 11.47 = Il. 12.84, Il. 11.273 = 399, Il. 11.783, Il. 21.230: Od. 3.267, Od. 12.268 = 273. In mid. Od. 21.240.– g With infin. to be supplied: ὄφρα μῦθον ἐνίσπω, ὃν Νέστωρ ἐπέτελλεν [ἐνισπεῖν] Il. 11.840.

data.quote: ὄφρα μῦθον ἐνίσπω, ὃν Νέστωρ ἐπέτελλεν [ἐνισπεῖν]

definition: ἐπιτέρπω [ἐπι- 4.] In mid., to take delight in. With dat.: ἔργοις Od. 14.228.
ἐπιτηδές In sufficient number: ἐν ἐρέτας ἐ. ἀγείρομεν Il. 1.142: μνηστήρων σʼ ἐ. ἀριστῆες λοχόωσιν (in force; or perh. here rather to be taken in sense with set purpose) Od. 15.28.

†ἐπιτίθημι [ἐπι- 5, ἐπι- 6 12 (18).] Fut. ἐπιθήσω Il. 23.796. 2 sing. -εις Il. 19.107. 3 sing. -ει Il. 4.190, Il. 20.369. 1 pl. -ομεν Od. 2.192. Aor. ἐπέθηκα Od. 19.256, Od. 23.194. 3 pl. -ε Il. 4.111, Il. 14.169, Il. 24.589: Od. 9.240, 243, 314, 340, Od. 10.545, Od. 13.370, Od. 21.45. 3 sing. aor. opt. ἐπιθείη Od. 9.314. 2 pl. ἐπιθεῖτε Il. 24.264: Od. 22.62. Imp. ἐπίθες Od. 22.157. Nom. dual masc. pple. ἐπιθέντε Od. 22.201. Fem. pple. ἐπιθεῖσα Od. 1.140, Od. 4.56, Od. 7.176, Od. 10.372, Od. 15.139, Od. 17.95. Infin. ἐπιθεῖναι Il. 5.751, Il. 7.364, 391, Il. 8.395: Od. 11.525. 1 To put or place upon something: οὐκ ἂν ταῦτʼ ἐπιθεῖτε; (sc. on the waggon) Il. 24.264. To put (food) on the table: εἴδατʼ ἐπιθεῖσα Od. 1.140 = Od. 4.56 = Od. 7.176 = Od. 10.372 = Od. 15.139 = Od. 17.95. To put or fit on something by way of completing or finishing or for ornament: ἐπέθηκε κορώνην Il. 4.111. Cf. Od. 19.256, Od. 21.45, Od. 23.194. To apply (a remedy): φάρμακα Il. 4.190. 2 To put or place upon. With genit.: Ἕκτορα λεχέων Il. 24.589. With dat.: κεφαλῇ καλύπτρην Od. 10.545. 3 With dat., to impose (a penalty) upon: σοὶ θωήν Od. 2.192. To give (fulfilment) to: οὐδὲ τέλος μύθῳ ἐπιθήσεις Il. 19.107. Cf. Il. 20.369. 4 To put to, shut (a door) Il. 14.169: Od. 22.157, 201. 5 To put in position (something covering or closing): νέφος Il. 5.751 = Il. 8.395: θυρεόν Od. 9.240 = 340, 314. App., to bring into action: λόχον Od. 11.525 (see ἀνακλίνω 1). 6 To apply (something covering or closing) to. With dat.: φαρέτρῃ πῶμα Od. 9.314. Cf. Od. 9.243, Od. 13.370. 7 To give in addition, add: οἴκοθεν ἄλλα Il. 7.364, 391. Cf. Il. 23.796: Od. 22.62.
ἐπιτιμήτωρ ὁ [ἐπι- 5 + τιμη-, τιμάω. One who honours.] A patron or protector Od. 9.270.

†*ἐπιτλάω [ἐπι- 5 + τλάω.] 3 sing. aor. imp. ἐπιτλήτω. 1 To be patient, to acquiesce in something proposed Il. 23.591. 2 To lend a patient ear to, let oneself be ruled by. With dat.: ἐπιτλήτω τοι κραδίη μύθοισιν ἐμοῖσιν Il. 19.220.
ἐπιτολμάω [ἐπι- 5.] 1 To steel oneself to endure something Od. 17.238. 2 To steel or resign oneself to do. With infin.: ἐπιτολμάτω κραδίη ἀκούειν Od. 1.353.
ἐπίτονος ὁ [ἐπι- 7 + τον-, τείνω.] The backstay of a mast (cf. πρότονοι) Od. 12.423.
ἐπιτοξάζομαι [ἐπι- 11.] To shoot at, use the bow against. With dat.: Ἕκτορι Il. 3.79.
ἐπιτραπέω [ἐπι- 11 + τραπ-, τρέπω.] To commit or leave a duty to. With dat. and infin.: Τρωσὶ φυλάσσειν Il. 10.421.

ἐπιτρέπω [ἐπι- 11]. 2 sing. aor. ἐπέπρεψας Il. 21.473. 3 sing. -ε Il. 10.116. 2 sing. opt. ἐπιτρέψειας Od. 15.24. 3 sing. -ειε Od. 7.149. Imp. ἐπίτρεψον Od. 19.502. Infin. ἐπιτρέψαι Od. 21.279, Od. 22.289. 1 pl. aor. ἐπετράπομεν Il. 10.59. Imp. pl. ἐπιτράπετε Il. 17.509. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπετράπετο Od. 9.12. 3 sing. pf. pass. ἐπιτέτραπται Il. 5.750, Il. 8.394. 3 pl. ἐπιτετράφαται Il. 2.25, 62. 1 In mid., of the mind, etc., to be turned or inclined in a specified direction, to be bent or set on doing. With infin.: σοὶ θυμὸς ἐπετράπετο εἴρεσθαι (is set on . . .) Od. 9.12. 2 With dat. a To turn over, commit, entrust, leave to: ᾧ λαοὶ ἐπιτετράφαται Il. 2.25 = 62: μέντορι οἶκον Od. 2.226. Cf. Il. 5.750 = Il. 8.394, Il. 17.509: Od. 15.24, Od. 22.289. b To leave or bequeath to: παισὶ κτήματα Od. 7.149. c To commitor leave an indicated duty to: τοῖσι μάλιστα Il. 10.59. d To leave it to (a person) to do: σοὶ οἴῳ πονέεσθαι Il. 10.116.. e To leave a matter to, leave oneself in the hands of: θεοῖσιν Od. 19.502, Od. 21.279. 3 With dat., to yield or give up to: Ποσειδάωνι νίκην Il. 21.473. To yield or give in to: γήραϊ Il. 10.79.

ἐπιτρέχω [ἐπι- 11 14.] Genit. sing. neut. aor. pple. ἐπιθρέξαντος Il. 13.409. 3 sing. aor. ἐπέδραμε Il. 4.524, Il. 5.617. 3 dual ἐπεδραμέτην, ἐπιδραμέτην Il. 10.354, Il. 23.418, 433, 447. 3 pl. ἐπέδραμον Il. 14.421, Il. 18.527: Od. 14.30. 3 sing. pf. ἐπιδέδρομε Od. 6.45, Od. 20.357. 1 To run towards in its course, tend to approach. With dat.: ἅρμαθʼ ἵπποις ἐπέτρεχον Il. 23.504. 2 To run towards or up to a person, etc., with hostile intent: ἐπέδραμεν ὅς ῥʼ ἔβαλεν Il. 4.524. Of. Il. 5.617, Il. 10.354, Il. 14.421, Il. 18.527. Of dogs Od. 14.30. 3 To run after or in pursuit of a competitor in a race. Of horses Il. 23.418, 447. 4 To run over (a space). Of horses: πόσσον ἐπιδραμέτην Il. 23.433. Of a spear, to pass over (and graze) something: ἀσπὶς ἐπιθρέξαντος ἄϋσεν ἔγχεος (genit. absolute) Il. 13.409. 5 In pf., of light, to play or be shed upon something: λευκὴ ἐπιδέδρομεν αἴγλη Od. 6.45. Of a mist, to be spread over something Od. 20.357.
ἐπιτρέψαι aor. infin. ἐπιτρέπω.
ἐπιτροχάδην [ἐπιτροχ-, ἐπιτρέχω.] 1 Trippingly on the tongue, without stumbling: ἀγόρευεν Il. 3.213. 2 Fluently, too fluently, with a torrent of words Od. 18.26.
†ἐπιφέρω [ἐπι- 5.] 3 sing. fut. ἐποίσει Il. 1.89: Od. 16.438. Aor. ἐπένεικα Il. 19.261. To lay (a hand or one's hands) upon. With dat.: σοὶ χεῖρας Il. 1.89. Cf. Il. 19.261: Od. 16.438.
ἐπιφθονέω [ἐπι- 5.] To grudge something to, be disinclined to grant something to: ᾧ κʼ ἐπιφθονέοις, ὁ δʼ εἶσιν ὀπίσσω Od. 11.149.

data.quote: ᾧ κʼ ἐπιφθονέοις, ὁ δʼ εἶσιν ὀπίσσω

definition: ἐπιφλέγω [ἐπι- 14 19.] 1 To burn up, consume: νεκρὸν πῦρ Il. 23.52. 2 To blaze or rage over or through. With acc.: ὕλην Il. 2.455.

†ἐπιφράζω [ἐπι- 5.] 2 sing. aor. mid. ἐπεφράσω Il. 21.410. 3 sing. ἐπεφράσατο Il. 5.665: Od. 8.94, 533. 3 sing. subj. ἐπιφράσσεται Od. 15.444. 1 pl. opt. ἐπιφρασσαίμεθα Il. 13.741. 3 pl. ἐπιφρασσαίατο Il. 2.282: Od. 18.94. 2 sing. aor. pass. ἐπεφράσθης Od. 5.183. In mid. and pass. 1 To think of, have the wit to do: τὸ οὔ τις ἐπεφράσατο, μηροῦ ἐξερύσαι δόρυ (it did not occur to them) Il. 5.665. 2 To take (counsel): ἐπιφρασσαίμεθʼ ἂν βουλήν Il. 13.741. 3 To think of, have the wit to think of, devise: τὸν μῦθον ἀγορεῦσαι Od. 5.183 (the infin. complementary). To devise, contrive: ὑμῖν ὄλεθρον Od. 15.444. 4 To mark, note something regarding: Ἀλκίνοός μιν οἶος ἐπεφράσατο Od. 8.94 = 533, ἵνα μή μιν ἐπιφρασσαίατʼ Ἀχαιοί (lest he should betray himself) Od. 18.94. To mark, get into one's head. With dependent clause: οὐκ ἐπεφράσω ὅσσον ἀρείων εὔχομʼ ἔμεναι Il. 21.410. To get cognizance of, learn, hear: βουλήν Il. 2.282.

data.quote: τὸ οὔ τις ἐπεφράσατο, μηροῦ ἐξερύσαι δόρυ
οὐκ ἐπεφράσω ὅσσον ἀρείων εὔχομʼ ἔμεναι

definition: ἐπιφρονέω [ἐπίφρων.] To mark or discern what should be marked or discerned: ὡς σὺ ἐπιφρονέουσʼ ἀγορεύεις (showing good discernment) Od. 19.385.

ἐπιφροσύνη -ης, ἡ [ἐπίφρων.] 1 Sagacity or adroitness in an emergency Od. 5.437. 2 In pl., sense or prudence leading one to do something specified: αἲ γὰρ ἐπιφροσύνας ἀνέλοιο οἴκου κήδεσθαι Od. 19.22.

data.quote: αἲ γὰρ ἐπιφροσύνας ἀνέλοιο οἴκου κήδεσθαι

definition: ἐπίφρων -ονος [app. ἐπι- 5 + φρήν. Applying the mind to something.] 1 Having good sense, well-balanced in mind, shrewd, sagacious Od. 23.12.– 2 Of counsel, wise, shrewd, sagacious Od. 3.128, Od. 16.242, Od. 19.326.
ἐπιχειρέω [ἐπι- 5 + χείρ.] To lay hands upon, apply oneself to. With dat.: δείπνῳ Od. 24.386. Cf. Od. 24.395.

†ἐπιχέω [ἐπι- 12 15.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπέχευε Od. 1.136, Od. 4.52, Od. 7.172, Od. 10.368, Od. 15.135, Od. 17.91. Infin. ἐπιχεῦαι Il. 24.303. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπεχεύατο Od. 5.257, 487. 3 pl. aor. pass. ἐπέχυντο Il. 15.654, Il. 16.295. 1 To pour over a person's hands: χέρνιβα Od. 1.136 = Od. 4.52 = Od. 7.172 = Od. 10.368 = Od. 15.135 = Od. 17.91. 2 To pour over (the hands). With dat.: χερσὶν ὕδωρ Il. 24.303. 3 In mid., to pile up on oneself, cover oneself with: χύσιν ἐπεχεύατο φύλλων Od. 5.487. To pile up or dispose against something: πολλὴν ἐπεχεύατο ὕλην Od. 5.257 (i.e., app., set it outside the wicker-work as additional protection). 4 In pass., of persons, to stream or be spread over an indicated or specified space: τοὶ δʼ ἐπέχυντο Il. 15.654. Cf. Il. 16.295.

ἐπιχθόνιος [ἐπι- 1 + χθον-, χθών.] Dwelling on earth. Epithet of men Il. 1.266, 272, Il. 2.553, Il. 4.45, Il. 9.558, Il. 24.505: Od. 1.167, Od. 8.479, Od. 18.136, Od. 22.414 = Od. 23.65. Absol. in pl., the dwellers on earth: ἄλλος ἐπιχθονίων Il. 24.220. Cf. Od. 17.115, Od. 24.197.
†ἐπιχράω [ἐπι- 5 + χράω2.] 3 pl. aor. ἐπέχραον. With dat., to attack, assail, lay hands upon: λύκοι ἄρνεσσιν Il. 16.352, Δαναοὶ Τρώεσσιν 356. To assail with importunities, beset: μητέρι Od. 2.50.

ἐπιχρίω [ἐπι- 5.] Aor. pple. ἐπιχρίσασα Od. 18.172. 1 To apply unguent to, anoint (one's person or a part thereof): παρειάς Od. 18.172. In mid.: χρῶτʼ ἐπιχρίεσθαι Od. 18.179. 2 To besmear: [τόξον] ἀλοιφῇ Od. 21.179.
ἐπιψαύω [ἐπι- 5.] To exercise the power of touch in an indicated direction. Fig.: ὅς τʼ ὀλίγον περ ἐπιψαύῃ πραπίδεσσιν (has even a little range with his wits) Od. 8.547.

data.quote: ὅς τʼ ὀλίγον περ ἐπιψαύῃ πραπίδεσσιν

definition: ἐπιωγή [ἐπι- 5 + ἰωγή.] A place where ships may lie under the lee of the land, a roadstead Od. 5.404.
ἐπιών pple. ἔπειμι2.
ἔπλεξε 3 sing. aor. πλέκω.
ἔπλετο 3 sing. aor. mid. πέλω.
ἔπληντο 3 pl. aor. pass. πελάζω.
ἐπλήσθη 3 sing. aor. pass. πίμπλημι.
ἔπνευσε 3 sing. aor. πνέω.
ἐποίσει 3 sing. fut. ἐπιφέρω.

ἐποίχομαι [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 11 14.] 1 With acc., to go towards, to go to join: μνηστῆρας ἐπῴχετο Od. 1.324. In hostile sense, to assail, attack. Of Apollo: οὐρῆας Il. 1.50. So absol.: ἐποιχόμενος κατέπεφνεν Il. 24.759: Od. 3.280 = Od. 15.411. Of Artemis. Absol. Od. 5.124 = Od. 11.173 = 199. Of a hero under the inspiration of a divinity. Of Diomedes Il. 5.330, Il. 10.487. Of Hector Il. 15.279. 2 To range, go about, go hither and thither: πάντοσε Il. 5.508, Μυρμιδόνας ἐποιχόμενος θώρηξεν Il. 16.155. Cf. Il. 6.81, Il. 10.167, 171, Il. 16.496 = 533, Il. 16.215: Od. 6.282. Of missiles Il. 1.383. 3 To range or go hither and thither over. With acc.: νηῶν ἴκρια Il. 15.676. Of sound: [ἀϋτὴ] πάσας [πύλας] ἐπῴχετο Il. 12.340 (v. l. πᾶσαι ἐπώχατο). 4 To go round a company: ἐπῴχετο οἰνοχοεύων Od. 1.143. Cf. Od. 17.346 = 351. 5 With acc., to range or go hither and thither round or among: πάντας ἐπῴχετο κελεύων Il. 17.356. To go round or among, inspect, review: πάσας [φώκας] Od. 4.451. 6 To walk along (the web) following the shuttle, to work at (the web). With acc.: ἱστὸν ἐποιχομένην Il. 1.31. Cf. Od. 5.62, Od. 10.222, 226, 254. 7 Hence, in gen., to ply (one's task): ἔργον ἐποίχεσθαι Il. 6.492: Od. 1.358, Od. 17.227, Od. 18.363, Od. 21.352. To go to see about, busy oneself about: δόρπον Od. 13.34. Absol., to go about a task: ἐποιχομένη ἔντυεν ἵππους Il. 5.720 = Il. 8.382.
ἐπόμνυμι [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 4 + ὄμνυμι.] 3 sing. aor. ἐπώμοσε Il. 10.332. To take an oath at one's bidding: ἐπόμνυον ὡς ἐκέλευεν Od. 15.437 = Od. 18.58. Cf. Il. 10.332.
ἐπομφάλιος [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1 + ὀμφαλός.] In neut. ἐπομφάλιον as adv., on the boss (of a shield): βάλε σάκος ἐπομφάλιον Il. 7.267.
ἐποπίζομαι [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] To have regard for, respect, shrink from incurring: Διὸς μῆνιν Od. 5.146.
ἐποπτάω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1.] To roast upon something indicated: ἐπώπτων ἔγκατα Od. 12.363.
ἐποπτεύω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 14 + ὀπτεύω, fr. ὀπ-. See ὁράω.] (διοπτεύω.) 3 sing. pa. iterative ἐποπτεύεσκε. To go over, visit, inspect: ἔργα Od. 16.140.
ἔπορε 3 sing. aor. πόρω.
†ἐπορέγω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 11.] Aor. pple. mid. ἐπορεξάμενος. In mid., to reach towards a person in order to strike him: ἐπορεξάμενος οὔτασε χεῖρα Il. 5.335.

†ἐπόρνυμι [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] Also ἐπορνύω Il. 15.613. 3 sing. aor. ἐπῶρσε Il. 17.72, Il. 20.93, Il. 22.204: Od. 5.109, Od. 7.271, Od. 9.67, Od. 22.429. 3 pl. opt. ἐπόρσειαν Il. 7.42. Imp. ἔπορσον Il. 5.765. 3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπῶρτο Il. 21.324, 1 To rouse to action, stir up: μένος Il. 20.93, Il. 22.204. To incite to do. With infin.: πολεμίζειν Il. 7.42. 2 With dat. a To rouse or incite to action against, set on: Ἀθηναίην οἱ Il. 5.765. Cf. Il. 17.72. To rouse or set in motion (a natural force) against: νηυσὶν ἄνεμον Od. 9.67. Cf. Od. 5.109. b To bring (something evil) upon: ὀϊζύν μοι Od. 7.271. Cf. Il. 15.613. c To cause (sleep) to come to: τῇ ὕπνον Od. 22.429. 3 In mid., to rouse or bestir oneself to action against, rush upon. With dat.: ἐπῶρτʼ Ἀχιλῆϊ Il. 21.324.

ἐπορούω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 11.] 1 To rush at a foe, make an attack or assault: τρὶς ἐπόρουσεν Il. 5.436, Il. 16.784, Il. 20.445. Cf. Il. 3.379, Il. 13.541, Il. 16.330, Il. 20.284, 442, Il. 21.33, Il. 22.138. To rush up in order to strip a fallen foe: ἐπόρουσε καὶ αἴνυτο τεύχεα Il. 11.580. Cf. Il. 13.550, Il. 15.579. 2 With dat. a To rush at, attack, assail: αἰνείᾳ Il. 5.432. Cf. Il. 4.472, Il. 11.256, Il. 15.520, 525, Il. 16.320, Il. 21.144, 392. b To rush or speed to or towards as a helper: τυδεΐδῃ Il. 5.793. c Of sleep, to come irresistibly, fall, upon: Ὀδυσσῆϊ Od. 23.343. 3 To rush to (and mount) (a chariot). With acc.: ἅρμʼ ἐπορούσας Il. 17.481.
ἔπορσον aor. imp. ἐπόρνυμι.

ἔπος τό (ϝέπος). [Cf. (ϝ)εῖπον.] Dat. sing. ἔπεϊ Il. 5.879. ἔπει Il. 1.395, 504, Il. 15.106. Dat. pl. ἐπέεσσι Il. 1.223, Il. 3.38, Il. 12.267, Il. 15.162, etc.: Od. 2.189, Od. 7.17, Od. 10.173, Od. 16.279, etc. ἔπεσσι Il. 9.113, Il. 10.542, etc.: Od. 4.484, Od. 5.96, Od. 9.258, Od. 17.545, etc. ἔπεσι Il. 1.77, 150, 211, Il. 2.73, Il. 23.682: Od. 8.170, Od. 17.374, Od. 24.161. 1 Something said, an utterance or speech, a word: ἐ. ἔφατο Il. 1.361, ἅλιον ἐ. ἔκβαλον Il. 18.324. Cf. Il. 2.807, Il. 3.204, Il. 4.350, Il. 5.170, etc.: Od. 3.226, 374, Od. 4.503, Od. 8.241, etc. What one has to say, discourse, words: ἵνʼ ἐ. ἀκούσῃς ἡμέτερον Od. 11.561. An element of speech, a word: τά μοι ἔειπε, τῶν οὐδέν τοι κρύψω ἐ. Od. 4.350 = Od. 17.141. 2 In pl., speech, discourse, words: ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα Il. 1.201, ὄτρυνεν ἐπέεσσιν Il. 3.249, ἐπέεσσι καθάπτετο Il. 15.127. Cf. Il. 1.223, 304, 519, Il. 2.73, 75, etc.: Od. 2.189, 323, Od. 3.264, Od. 4.286, Od. 11.99, etc. 3 In pl., words, speech, as distinguished from action: ἔπεσιν ὀνείδισον Il. 1.211, ἐπέεσσί κʼ ἀθανάτοισι μαχοίμην Il. 20.367. Cf. Il. 16.628, Il. 20.200, 211, 256, 431: Od. 6.143, 146. Contrasted in terms with χεῖρες Il. 1.77, Il. 16.630. In sing. with ἔργον Il. 1.395, 504, Il. 5.879, Il. 15.234: Od. 2.272, 304, Od. 3.99 = Od. 4.329, Od. 4.163, Od. 11.346, Od. 15.375. In pl.: ἐπέων ἠδὲ καὶ ἔργων Il. 11.703. With βίη: ἢ ἔπει ἠὲ βίῃ Il. 15.106. 4 The sense of the word coloured by the context Il. 1.108 (a prediction), 150 (your orders), 216 (your injunction), 419 (your prayer), 543 (your intention), Il. 2.361 (the counsel), Il. 3.83 (a proposal), Il. 7.375 (proposal), 394 (proposal), Il. 8.8 (my announced purpose, my will), Il. 9.100 (say what is in your mind and hearken to what another has to say), Il. 11.652 (tidings), 788 (counsel), Il. 14.44 (the threat), 212 (your request), 234 (my request), Il. 15.156 (the commands), 162 (my commands), 178 (his commands), 566 (his exhortation), Il. 16.236 (my prayer), 686 (the injunction), Il. 17.701 (tidings), Il. 18.273 (counsel), Il. 19.121 (a piece of news), Il. 22.454 (the thing which I say (the thing being identified with the words)), Il. 23.544 (what you propose), Il. 24.75 (a suggestion), 92 and 224 (his injunction), 744 (counsel): Od. 3.243 (a question), Od. 4.137, 420 and 461 (questions), Od. 6.289 (counsel, directions), Od. 8.91 (his lays), 141 (this proposal of yours), 358 (your request), Od. 10.178 (exhortation), 428 (orders), Od. 11.146 (directions), 348 (this suggestion), Od. 12.222 (exhortation), 266 (injunction), Od. 14.131 (a story), Od. 15.536 = Od. 17.163 = Od. 19.309 (prediction), Od. 16.469 (the news), Od. 17.519 (lays), 584 (cf. Il. 9.100 above), Od. 18.166 (a warning), Od. 19.98 (cf. Il. 9.100 above), 565 (idle promises), Od. 20.115 (wish, prayer), 236 (prediction), Od. 21.278 (counsel).

data.ref: Il. 22.454 (the thing which I say (the thing being identified with the words)),

data.quote: τά μοι ἔειπε, τῶν οὐδέν τοι κρύψω ἐ.

definition: ἐποτρύνω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 5.] 2 sing. aor. ἐπότρυνας Od. 8.185. 3 sing. -ε Il. 15.456. Subj. ἐποτρύνω Il. 16.525: Od. 1.89. 2 sing. -ῃς Od. 2.189. 3 sing. -ῃσι Il. 16.690: Od. 8.45. -ῃ Il. 10.130, Il. 15.148: Od. 9.139. 2 dual -ητον Il. 6.83. 3 pl. -ωσι Od. 24.355. 3 sing. opt. ἐποτρύνειε Od. 14.461, 498. Imp. ἐπότρυνον Il. 15.258: Od. 6.36. Pple. ἐποτρύνας Od. 2.422, Od. 9.488, Od. 10.128, Od. 11.44, etc. Indin. ἐποτρῦναι Od. 10.531. 1 pl. aor. subj. mid. ἐποτρυνώμεθα Od. 8.31. 1 a To rouse or stir to action, incite, urge, press, exhort: φάλαγγας Il. 6.83, Ὀδυσῆα Il. 8.92. Cf. Il. 10.130, Il. 15.43: Od. 1.89, Od. 5.139, Od. 8.185, Od. 14.461, Od. 17.395. b With complementary infin.: τάφρον διαβαινέμεν Il. 12.50. Cf. Il. 13.767 = Il. 17.117 = 683, Il. 15.456, Il. 16.525, 690, Il. 17.178: Od. 8.45. c With dat. and infin.: ἱππεῦσιν ἐλαυνέμεν ἵππους Il. 15.258. Cf. Od. 10.531. d With acc. and infin.: ἑὲ αὐτὸν μαχέσασθαι Il. 20.171. Cf. Od. 2.189, Od. 6.36, Od. 14.498, Od. 15.73. e With acc. of what one is urged to do: ὅττι κʼ ἐποτρύνῃ Il. 15.148. f Absol.: εἰς ὅ κε θυμὸς ἐποτρύνῃ Od. 9.139. Cf. Il. 6.439, Il. 12.442, Il. 13.94 = 480 = Il. 17.219, Il. 15.725, Il. 17.553, Il. 20.364, 373, Il. 24.297: Od. 2.422 = Od. 15.217 = 287, Od. 7.262, Od. 9.488, 561, Od. 10.128, Od. 11.44, Od. 14.79, Od. 15.208, Od. 24.175. 2 To hasten on with, press on. In mid.: ἐποτρυνώμεθα πομπήν Od. 8.31. 3 To stir up (strife) against. With dat.: νῶϊν ἐποτρύνει πόλεμον Od. 22.152. 4 To dispatch (a message): ἀγγελίας Od. 24.355.
ἐπουράνιος [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 2 + οὐρανός.] Dwelling in the heavens. Epithet of the gods Il. 6.129, 131, 527. Of a god Od. 17.484.
†ἐποχέω [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 1 + ὀχέω.] 3 sing. fut. pass. ἐποχήσεται. To carry or bear upon. With dat.: μὴ τοῖς ἵπποισιν ἀνὴρ ἐποχήσεται ἄλλος Il. 10.330. Cf. Il. 17.449.

data.quote: μὴ τοῖς ἵπποισιν ἀνὴρ ἐποχήσεται ἄλλος

definition: ἐπόψεαι 2 sing. fut. See ἐφοράω.
ἔπραθον aor. πέρθω.
ἔπρηξας 2 sing. aor. πρήσσω.
ἔπρησε 3 sing. aor. πρήθω.

ἑπτά indeclinable. Seven Il. 2.719, Il. 6.421, Il. 9.85, 122 = 264, Il. 9.128, 149, 270, 291, Il. 19.243, 246, Il. 21.407: Od. 9.202, Od. 12.129, Od. 24.274. Absol.: ἑ. παρίσχομεν Il. 9.638. With another numeral: ἑ. καὶ δέκα Od. 5.278, Od. 7.267, Od. 24.63.
ἑπταβόειος [ἑπτά + βόειος.] Of seven layers of ox-hide: σάκος Il. 7.220, 222, 245, 266, Il. 11.545.
ἑπτάετες [ἑπτά + ἔτος.] For seven years: ἤνασσεν Od. 3.304, μένον Od. 7.259, Od. 14.285.
ἑπταπόδης [ἑπτά + ποδ-, πούς, foot, as a measure of length.] Seven-foot: θρῆνυν (app. raised seven feet) Il. 15.729.
ἑπτάπυλος -ον [ἑπτά + πύλη.] The seven-gated. Epithet of the Boeotian Thebes Il. 4.406: Od. 11.263.
ἔπταρε 3 sing. aor. πταίρω.
ἔπτατο 3 sing. aor. πέτομαι.
ἕπταχα [ἑπτά.] Into seven parts Od. 14.434.
ἔπτηξαν 3 pl. aor. πτήσσω.
ἐπτοίηθεν 3 pl. aor. pass. πτοιέω.
ἐπύθοντο 3 pl. aor. πεύθομαι.

ἕπω1 [σεπ-.] (ἀμφι-, δι-, ἐφ-, μεθ-.) 1 To handle, take into one's hands, turn over: τεύχεα Il. 6.321. 2 With advbs. a With ἀμφί. α To beset: ἀ. Ὀδυσῆα Τρῶες ἕπον Il. 11.483. β To busy oneself about: ἀ. βοὸς ἕπετον κρέα Il. 11.776. Cf. Il. 7.316: = Od. 19.421, Od. 8.61. b With ἐπί, to attend to: ἐ. ἔργον ἕποιεν Od. 14.195. c With μετά, to direct, look after: μ. τυδέος υἱὸν ἕπουσαν Il. 10.516. d With περί, to pull about, handle: περὶ τεύχεʼ ἕπουσιν Il. 15.555.

ἕπω2 [seq- σεπ-. Cf. L. sequor.] Only in mid. Imp. ἕπευ Il. 13.465, Il. 15.556: Od. 15.281, Od. 23.52, 78. Fut. ἕψομαι Il. 10.108: Od. 2.287, Od. 6.32. 2 sing. -εαι Il. 24.733. 3 sing. -εται Il. 4.415, Il. 24.182: Od. 3.359. 1 pl. -όμεθα Il. 13.785: Od. 23.127. 3 pl. -ονται Il. 4.63. Infin. ἕψεσθαι Od. 21.104. 2 sing. aor. ἕσπεο (σέσπεο) Il. 10.285. 3 sing. -ετο Il. 3.376, Il. 4.476, Il. 11.472, Il. 12.398, Il. 13.300, 492, Il. 15.559, Il. 16.632: Od. 1.125, Od. 4.276, Od. 6.164, Od. 8.109, Od. 17.53. 3 dual -έσθην Il. 3.239. 1 pl. -όμεθα Il. 1.158. 3 pl. subj. ἕσπωνται Od. 12.349. Opt. ἑσποίμην Od. 19.579, Od. 21.77. Pple. ἑσπόμενος -ου Il. 10.246, Il. 12.395, Il. 13.570. Without reduplication, imp. σπεῖο Il. 10.285 (app. for σπέο, the lengthening being due to the first arsis). 3 sing. σπέσθω Il. 12.350, 363. Infin. σπέσθαι Il. 5.423: Od. 4.38, Od. 22.324. (ἐφ-, μεθ-.) 1 a To follow in company with, go or come with, accompany, a person or persons or something: ἀλλʼ ἕπεο Il. 10.146. Cf. Il. 10.246, Il. 13.381, 465, Il. 15.556, Il. 18.387, 572: ἡ δʼ ἕσπετʼ Ἀθήνη Od. 1.125. Cf. Od. 5.91, Od. 10.313, 448, Od. 14.45, 482, Od. 15.162, 281, 470, Od. 23.52, 78, Od. 24.5. b With dat.: υἱέϊ σῷ Il. 3.174. Cf. Il. 9.428, Il. 10.108, Il. 12.91, Il. 13.300, Il. 22.450, etc.: Od. 3.376, Od. 4.276, Od. 6.276, Od. 14.298, Od. 15.81, Od. 19.245. c With ἅμα: θεοὶ ἅμα πάντες ἕποντο Il. 1.424. Cf. Il. 3.447, Il. 9.170, Il. 10.194, Il. 11.472 = Il. 15.559 = Il. 16.632, Il. 11.781, Il. 24.327: Od. 2.287, 413 = Od. 8.46 = 104, Od. 6.319, Od. 8.109, Od. 10.231 = 257. With ἅμα and dat.: τοκεῦσιν ἅμʼ ἕσπετο Il. 4.476. Cf. Il. 3.143, Il. 5.423, Il. 9.512, Il. 10.222, Il. 12.350, etc.: Od. 2.11, Od. 3.359, Od. 4.38, Od. 6.32, Od. 10.425, etc. d With μετά: μετὰ νέφος εἵπετο πεζῶν Il. 23.133. With μετά and dat.: μετά σφιν εἵπετο Il. 18.234. e With σύν: σὺν δʼ εἵπετʼ Ὀδυσσεύς Od. 10.436. With σύν and dat.: σὺν ἀμφιπόλοισιν ἕπεσθαι Od. 7.304. 2 Of herdsmen accompanying their herd. With ἅμα: δύω ἅμʼ ἕποντο νομῆες Il. 18.525: Od. 17.214 = Od. 20.175. With ἅμα and dat.: ἅμʼ ὕεσσιν ἑπέσθω Od. 15.397. Of their dogs following with them. With dat.: ἐννέα σφι κύνες ἕποντο Il. 18.578. Of sheep. With μετά and acc.: ὡς εἴ τε μετὰ κτίλον ἕσπετο μῆλα Il. 13.492. 3 To go with as one's wife. With dat.: σοὶ ἄλοχον σπέσθαι Od. 22.324. With ἅμα and dat.: ἦ ἅμʼ ἕπηται (ἕπωμαι) Ἀχαιῶν [κείνῳ] ὅς τις ἄριστος Od. 16.76, Od. 19.528, τῷ κεν ἅμʼ ἑσποίμην Od. 19.579 = Od. 21.77. Cf. Od. 21.104. 4 To go with, fall to the lot of. With dat.: τῷ κε νικήσαντι γυνὴ ἕποιτο Il. 3.255. 5 a To follow a person as one's chief or leader: λαοὶ ἕποντο Il. 13.492. Cf. Il. 4.430: Od. 3.363. To form part of an expedition, follow with the rest Il. 3.239, 240, Il. 24.400: Od. 11.493. b With dat.: παῦρός οἱ εἵπετο λαός Il. 2.675. Cf. Il. 2.619, Il. 4.91, Il. 9.44, Il. 11.228, Il. 12.78, etc.: Od. 3.165, Od. 4.536, Od. 6.164, Od. 9.159, Od. 11.168, etc. c With ἅμα: ἅμα νέφος εἵπετο πεζῶν Il. 4.274. Cf. Il. 5.591, Il. 11.796, Il. 12.124, Il. 13.690, 717, etc.: Od. 23.127, Od. 24.117. With ἅμα and dat.: σοὶ ἅμʼ ἑσπόμεθα Il. 1.158. Cf. Il. 2.524, 534, 542, 762, Il. 12.87, etc.: Od. 11.372, Od. 15.541, Od. 19.196. 6 a To follow up, hang upon, the foe: αἰὲν ἀποκτείνων ἕπετο Il. 11.154. Cf. Il. 11.165, 168, 565, 754, Il. 15.277, Il. 16.372, Il. 17.730. Of flowing water Il. 21.256. b With ἅμα: Τρῶες ἅμʼ ἕποντο Il. 17.753. c App., with ἀμφί, to beset: ἀμφʼ Ὀδυσσῆα Τρῶες ἕποντο Il. 11.474 (prob. ἕπον should be read. See 483 under ἕπω1 2.a.α). 7 To be in a person's service: ἓξ δρηστῆρες ἕπονται Od. 16.248. To be at the service of, fulfil the benests of. With dat.: πρεσβυτέροισιν Ἐρινύες αἰὲν ἕπονται Il. 15.204. 8 To keep up with, play one's part with. With dat.: ἕπεθʼ ἵπποις ἀθανάτοισιν Il. 16.154. Sim. of the limbs, to keep up with one's spirit or strength, play their part: εἴθʼ ὡς . . . ὥς τοι γούναθʼ ἕποιτο Il. 4.314. Cf. Od. 20.237 = Od. 21.202. 9 To follow the motion of, fall forward following. With dat.: ἑσπόμενος πέσε δουρί (i. e. as it was drawn back) Il. 12.395, ἑσπόμενος περὶ δουρί (transfixed by it and giving way before the blow; περί advbl.) Il. 13.570. 10 Of an inanimate object, to follow the motion of, come away with, something: ἔπαλξις ἕσπετο πᾶσα (came away, gave way) Il. 12.398. With dat.: προτὶ φρένες δουρὶ ἕποντο (came away with it; προτί advbl.) Il. 16.504. With ἅμα and dat.: τρυφάλεια ἅμʼ ἕσπετο χειρί Il. 3.376. 11 To fall in with something proposed, agree, concur: ἐπὶ δʼ ἕψονται θεοὶ ἄλλοι Il. 4.63. Cf. Od. 12.349. 12 Of a dowry, to go with, accompany. With ἐπί and genit.: ἔεδνα ὅσσα ἔοικε φίλης ἐπὶ παιδὸς ἕπεσθαι Od. 1.278 = Od. 2.197. 13 Of honour, to accompany, attend, come to. With dat.: Διὸς κούρῃσιν ἕπεσθαι τιμήν Il. 9.513. With ἅμα and dat.: τούτῳ κῦδος ἅμʼ ἕψεται Il. 4.415. 14 Of a quality, to go with, be shown in (a person). With dat.: ὅ τοι οὐκ ἕπετʼ ἀλκή Il. 8.140.

data.quote: ὡς εἴ τε μετὰ κτίλον ἕσπετο μῆλα
ἦ ἅμʼ ἕπηται (ἕπωμαι) Ἀχαιῶν [κείνῳ] ὅς τις ἄριστος
εἴθʼ ὡς . . . ὥς τοι γούναθʼ ἕποιτο
ἔεδνα ὅσσα ἔοικε φίλης ἐπὶ παιδὸς ἕπεσθαι

definition: ἐπώμοσε 3 sing. aor. ἐπόμνυμι.

ἐπώνυμος [ἐπ-, ἐπι- 4 + ὄνυμα, Aeolic form of ὄνομα.] Of a name, given on account of some particular circumstance: Ἀλκυόνην καλέεσκον ἐπώνυμον, οὕνεκα . . . Il. 9.562: Ἀρήτη ὄνομʼ ἐστὶν ἐπώνυμον Od. 7.54 (app. because she had been prayed for, fr. ἀρή1), Ὀδυσεὺς ὄνομʼ ἔστω ἐπώνυμον Od. 19.409 (the reason for the name being given in the preceding lines).
ἐπῶρσε 3 sing. aor. ἐπόρνυμι.
ἐπῶρτο 3 sing. aor. mid. ἐπόρνυμι.
ἐπώχατο 3 pl. plupf. pass. ἐπέχω.
ἐπῴχετο 3 sing. impf. ἐποίχομαι.
ἐράασθε 2 pl. impf. ἔραμαι.
ἔραζε To the earth, to the ground, on the ground: πῖπτον Il. 12.156, Il. 18.552. Cf. Il. 16.459, Il. 17.619, 633: Od. 15.527, Od. 22.20, 85, 280.

ἔραμαι 2 pl. impf. ἐράασθε Il. 16.208. Aor. ἠρασάμην Il. 14.317. 3 sing. ἠράσατο Il. 16.182. ἠράσσατο Il. 20.223: Od. 11.238. With genit. 1 To love, be in love with: σεο Il. 3.446 = Il. 14.328. In aor., to fall in love with: ὁπότʼ ἠρασάμην Ἰξιονίης ἀλόχοιο Il. 14.317. Cf. Il. 16.182, Il. 20.223: Od. 11.238. 2 To be fond of (something), long for, lust after (it): πολέμου Il. 9.64, φυλόπιδος Il. 16.208.
ἐραννός -ή, -όν [ἔραμαι. Lovely.] Fair, pleasant. Epithet of places Il. 9.531, 577: Od. 7.18.
ἔρανος -ου, ὁ. A feast to which the partakers contributed in shares (cf. εἰλαπίνη) Od. 1.226, Od. 11.415.

ἐρατεινός -ή, -όν [ἔραμαι. Lovely.] 1 An epithet of general commendation, pleasing, charming, delightful, fair, or the like: ὁμηλικίην Il. 3.175. Cf. Il. 6.156, Il. 19.347, 353, Il. 21.218: δαῖτα Od. 8.61, Od. 20.117, ἑτάροισιν ἐ. (a pleasing sight) Od. 9.230. Cf. Od. 4.13, Od. 23.300. 2 As epithet of places, fair, pleasant Il. 2.532, 571, 583, 591, 607, Il. 3.239, 401, 443, Il. 5.210, Il. 14.226, Il. 18.291: Od. 7.79.
ἐρατίζω [ἔραμαι.] To be greedy after. With genit.: κρειῶν ἐρατίζων Il. 11.551 = Il. 17.660.
ἐρατός [as ἐρατεινός.] = ἐρατεινός 1 Il. 3.64.

ἐργάζομαι [(ϝ)έργον.] 1 To do work, work, labour: σφίσιν ἐργάζεσθαι ἀνάγκῃ Od. 14.272 = Od. 17.441. Of a piece of apparatus, to do its work, operate Il. 18.469. 2 To do, perform: ἔργα ἀεικέα Il. 24.733. Cf. Od. 17.321, Od. 20.72 (complementary infin.), Od. 22.422 (do.), Od. 24.210. 3 To work upon, work up: χρυσόν Od. 3.435.
ἔργαθε 3 sing. aor. ἔργω1.
†ἔργνυμι [ = (ϝ)έργω1.] 3 sing. impf. ἐέργνυ. To shut up, confine: συφεοῖσιν (in the . . .) Od. 10.238.

ἔργον -ου, τό (ϝέργον) [cf. (ϝ)έρδω.] 1 Something done or performed or to be done or performed, a deed: ἃ Ζεὺς μήδετο ἔργα Il. 2.38, ὑπέσχετο μέγα ἐ. Il. 13.366. Cf. Il. 3.130, Il. 5.757, Il. 9.595, Il. 16.120, Il. 18.77, etc.: Od. 1.338, Od. 2.63, Od. 3.275, Od. 10.199, Od. 18.221, etc. For ἐ. contrasted in terms with ἔπος see ἔπος 3. 2 One's work, the work in hand or before one: μὴ ἀμβαλλώμεθα ἐ. Il. 2.436, ἀτελευτήτῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ Il. 4.175, ὄφρʼ ἐπὶ ἔργα τράπωνται Il. 23.53. Cf. Il. 2.137, Il. 7.465, Il. 18.473, Il. 19.150, 242: Od. 2.252, Od. 5.243, Od. 9.250 = 310 = 343, Od. 14.195, Od. 17.227, Od. 18.363, Od. 22.479. 3 Toilsome work, toil, labour: ἐ. ἀεικὲς ἔχοντα Il. 19.133. A task: ἔργα κʼ ἀεικέα ἐργάζοιο Il. 24.733. 4 A kind of work or activity, a sphere of action: ἐν πάντεσσʼ ἔργοισι δαήμονα Il. 23.671. Cf. Il. 4.258: ἔργα κάκʼ ἔμμαθεν Od. 17.226. Cf. Od. 8.245, Od. 14.228, Od. 15.320, Od. 18.362, Od. 20.378. 5 The process or condition of working, work, action: ἀνηνύστῳ ἐπὶ ἔργῳ (with no end to the business) Od. 16.111.
