Il. 1.244. With dat. of the person against whom one feels anger : ἀνδρὶ χέρηϊ Il. 1.80. Cf. Il. 9.555, Il. 21.306, 413, Il. 24.606 : Od. 5.215, Od. 23.213. With genit. of the cause : χωόμενος ἐϋζώνοιο γυναικός Il. 1.429. Cf. Il. 2.689, Il. 13.165, 662, Il. 16.553, Il. 20.29, Il. 21.457, Il. 23.37. With the cause in acc. : μή μοι τόδε χώεο Od. 5.215, Od. 23.213.

χωρέω [χῶρος.] (ἀνα-, ὑπο-.) To withdraw, retire, give way : χώρησαν δʼ ὑπὸ πρόμαχοι Il. 4.505= Il. 16.588= Il. 17.316, χώρησε τυτθὸν ἐπάλξιος (from the . . .) Il. 12.406, οὐδʼ ἂν Ἀχιλλῆϊ χωρήσειεν (give way to him, retire before him) Il. 13.324. Cf. Il. 13.724, Il. 15.655, Il. 16.592, 629, Il. 17.101, 533, Il. 18.244.

χώρη -ης, ἡ [cf. χῶρος.] 1 A place or spot : στρέψεσθʼ ἐκ χώρης ὅθι . . . Il. 6.516 : θῆκʼ αὐτῇ ἐνὶ χώρῃ (in the place from which he had taken it) Od. 21.366. Cf. Od. 23.186. The place occupied by one, one's place : στρεφθεὶς ἐκ χώρης Od. 16.352. Cf. Il. 23.349. 2 A land, country, region : ἅς τινας ἵκεο χώρας ἀνθρώπων Od. 8.573. 3 A space or extent of ground : ὀλίγῃ ἐνὶ χώρῃ Il. 17.394. Space, extent of ground : χώρης ὀλίγην μοῖραν Il. 16.68. Cf. Il. 23.521.

χωρίς 1 Separately, apart, so as to be divided or parted from others : ἔρχατο, χ. μὲν πρόγονοι, χ. δὲ μέτασσαι, χ. δʼ αὖθʼ ἕρσαι Od. 9.221. Cf. Od. 24.78. 2 Separately, so as not to be in common or shared with others or another : χ. Ἀτρεΐδῃς δῶκε μέθυ Il. 7.470. Cf. Od. 4.130. 3 Separately, besides : χ. [δῶκα] γυναῖκας Od. 24.278.

data.quote: ἔρχατο, χ. μὲν πρόγονοι, χ. δὲ μέτασσαι, χ. δʼ αὖθʼ ἕρσαι

definition: χῶρος -ου, ὁ [cf. χώρη.] 1 A place or spot : ἐς χῶρον ἕνα ξυνιόντες ἵκοντο Il. 4.446= Il. 8.60, χῶρον, ὅθʼ ἕστασαν ἵπποι Il. 10.520. Cf. Il. 13.473, Il. 17.54, Il. 21.262, Il. 23.138 : Od. 1.426, Od. 5.442, Od. 7.123, Od. 9.181, Od. 11.22, Od. 21.142, etc. 2 A space or extent of ground : ὅθι νεκύων διεφαίνετο χῶρος Il. 8.491= Il. 10.199. Cf. Il. 10.161, Il. 12.423. A space, place, region : κάλυψε (βάθυνε) χῶρον ἅπαντα Il. 23.189, 421. A space set apart for some purpose : χῶρον διεμέτρεον Il. 3.315. Cf. Il. 3.344. 3 A tract of country, a region : χῶρον ἀνʼ ὑλήεντα Il. 10.362 : Od. 14.2. A land, country, region : χώρου ἄϊδρις ἐών Od. 10.282. Cf. Od. 11.94.
χώσατο 3 sing. aor. χώομαι.

ψάμαθος -ου, ἡ [cf. ἄμαθος and ψάμμος.] 1 Sand : ὡς ὅτε τις ψάμαθον πάϊς [ἐρείπῃ] (a sand-castle) Il. 15.362 : ψαμάθῳ εἰλυμένα Od. 14.136. In pl. in sim. sense : αὐτόν μιν εἰλύσω ψαμάθοισιν Il. 21.319. Cf. Il. 7.462, Il. 12.31. 2 Sand as commonly occurring by the sea or by rivers, the sand, the sands : ἐπὶ ψαμάθῳ ἔθεσαν Od. 13.119. In pl. : νῆα ἔρυσσαν ἐπὶ ψαμάθοις Il. 1.486. Cf. Il. 21.202, Il. 23.15, 853 : Od. 3.38, Od. 4.426, 438, 539, Od. 9.546= Od. 12.5, Od. 13.284, Od. 22.387. The particles considered separately with reference to their number : ὅσα ψάμαθός τε κόνις τε Il. 9.385. In pl. : ψαμάθοισιν [ἐοικότες] Il. 2.800.
ψάμμος -ου, ἡ [cf. ψάμαθος.] =ψάμαθος. (1) : γαῖα ψάμμῳ κυανέη Od. 12.243.
ψάρ ψήρ A starling Il. 16.583, Il. 17.755.

ψαύω (ἐπι-) 1 To be so close together as to touch, to touch : ψαῦον κόρυθες φάλοισιν Il. 13.132= Il. 16.216. 2 To come into contact with, bring something into contact with, touch. With genit. : ψαύουσιν ἐπισσώτρου τρίχες Il. 23.519, ὸππότερός κε ψαύσῃ ἐνδίνων 806.
ψεδνός -ή, -όν. Sparse, scanty, thin : λάχνη Il. 2.219.
ψευδάγγελος -ον [ψεῦδος + ἄγγελος.] Falsifying one's message Il. 15.159.
ψευδής [ψεύδομαι.] Breaking one's troth. Absol., one guilty of doing this : οὐκ ἐπὶ ψευδέσσι Ζεὺς ἔσσετʼ ἀρωγός Il. 4.235 (u.l. ψεύδεσσιν; see ψεῦδος 1).

data.quote: οὐκ ἐπὶ ψευδέσσι Ζεὺς ἔσσετʼ ἀρωγός

definition: ψεύδομαι Fut. ψεύσομαι Il. 10.534 : Od. 4.140. Nom. pl. aor. pple. ψευσάμενοι Il. 7.352. Nom. sing. fem. ψευσαμένη Il. 6.163. 1 To speak falsely, lie, use deceit : κομιδῆς κεχρημένοι ψεύδονται Od. 14.125. Cf. Il. 6.163 : Od. 14.365. 2 To break (a treaty) : ὅρκια ψευσάμενοι Il. 7.352. 3 To make an inaccurate or incorrect statement, speak erroneously, be wrong in what one says : ψεύσομαι, ἦ ἔτυμον ἐρέω; Il. 10.534 := Od. 4.140. Cf. Il. 4.404, Il. 5.635.

ψεῦδος τό [ψεύδομαι.] 1 A falsehood, lie, piece of deceit : ψ. κεν φαῖμεν Il. 2.81= Il. 24.222, γνώμεναι εἴ τε ψ. ὑπόσχεσις (whether he promised only to deceive) Il. 2.349. Cf. Il. 21.276 : Od. 3.20 = 328, Od. 11.366, Od. 14.296, 387, Od. 19.203. In pl., sharp practice : ψεύδεσσι βιησάμενος Il. 23.576. An oath-breaking (cf. ψεύδομαι 2). In pl. : ψεύδεσσιν ἀρωγός (an abettor in oath-breaking) Il. 4.235 (u.l. ψευδέσσιν; see ψευδής). 2 An inaccurate, incorrect or erroneous statement : οὔ τι ψ. ἐμὰς ἄτας κατέλεξας (all you have said is but the truth) Il. 9.115.

data.quote: οὔ τι ψ. ἐμὰς ἄτας κατέλεξας

definition: ψεύσομαι fut. ψεύδομαι.
ψευστέω [ψεύστης.] = ψεύδομαι 3 : ψευστήσεις (the event will falsify your boast) Il. 19.107.
ψεύστης ὁ [ψευσ-, ψεύδομαι.] A liar : ψεῦσταί τʼ ὀρχησταί τε Il. 24.261.
†ψηλαφάω Pres. pple. ψηλαφόων. To feel or grope about : χερσὶ ψηλαφόων Od. 9.416.
ψήρ See ψάρ.
ψηφίς -ῖδος, ἡ. A pebble Il. 21.260.
ψιάς -άδος, ἡ. A drop Il. 16.459.
ψιλός -ή, -όν. Bare: ἄροσιν (freed from trees or other encumbrances, cleared) Il. 9.580 : νῆα ψιλὴν φέρε κῦμα (her timbers gone) Od. 12.421, δέρμα (stripped of the hair) Od. 13.437.
ψολόεις -εντος [ψόλος, smoke.] Accompanied by smoke, smoky : κεραυνῷ Od. 23.330. Cf. Od. 24.539.
ψύξασα aor. pple. fem. ψύχω.

ψυχή -ῆς, ἡ. 1 The animating principle, the vital spirit, the soul, the life, life, one's life (cf. θυμός I.1.b) : λύθη ψυχή τε μένος τε Il. 5.296= Il. 8.123=315. Cf. Il. 11.334, Il. 21.569, Il. 22.257, 325, 338, 467, Il. 23.104, Il. 24.754 : κεκαδήσει θυμοῦ καὶ ψυχῆς Od. 21.154, 171. Cf. Od. 9.523. In pl. in reference to a number of persons : ψυχὰς ὀλέσαντες Il. 13.763= Il. 24.168. Cf. Od. 22.444. 2 Animate existence viewed as a possession, one's life : ἐμὴν ψυχὴν παραβαλλόμενος Il. 9.322, ψυχῆς ἀντάξιον 401 : ψυχὰς παρθέμενοι Od. 3.74= Od. 9.255. 3 Animate existence viewed with regard to its duration, one's life or continued existence : περὶ ψυχῆς θέον Ἕκτορος Il. 22.161 : ἀρνύμενος ἣν ψυχήν Od. 1.5, ὥς τε περὶ ψυχῆς Od. 9.423. In pl. in reference to a number of persons : ὅσσοι περὶ ψυχέων ἐμάχοντο Od. 22.245. 4 The spirit or soul thought of as distinct from the body and as leaving it at death (cf. θυμός I.1.c) : πολλὰς ψυχὰς Ἄϊδι προΐαψεν Il. 1.3, τὸν δὲ λίπε ψυχή Il. 5.696, ψυχὴ πάλιν ἐλθεῖν οὐ λεϊστή Il. 9.408. Cf. Il. 5.654= Il. 11.445, Il. 7.330, Il. 14.518, Il. 16.453, 505, 625, 856= Il. 22.362 : ψυχὴ ἀποπταμένη πεπότηται Od. 11.222. Cf. Od. 10.560= Od. 11.65, Od. 14.134, 426 (of a pig), Od. 18.91. 5 A disembodied spirit, a shade : ψυχὴ Πατροκλῆος Il. 23.65, ψυχαί, εἴδωλα καμόντων 72. Cf. Il. 23.100, 106, 221 : ψυχῇ (ψυχὴ) Τειρεσίαο Od. 10.492= 565, Od. 11.90, 165, Od. 23.251, 323. Cf. Od. 10.530, Od. 11.37, 51, 84, 141, 150, 205, 385, 387, 467, 471, 538, 541, 543, 564, 567, Od. 24.1, 14, 15, 20, 23, 35=191, 100, 102, 105, 120.
ψῦχος τό [ψύχω.] Coolness Od. 10.555.

ψυχρός -ή, -όν [ψύχω.] Cold : νιφάδες Il. 19.358. Cf. Il. 15.171, Il. 22.152 : αὔρη Od. 5.469. Cf. Od. 9.392, Od. 14.477, Od. 17.209, Od. 19.388. Of the bronze of a weapon : ψυχρὸν ἕλε χαλκὸν ὀδοῦσιν Il. 5.75.
†ψύχω Aor. pple. fem. ψύξασα. (ἀνα-, ἀπο-) To breathe, blow : ἦκα ψύξασα Il. 20.440.
ψωμός -οῦ, ὁ. A bit or gobbet Od. 9.374.

ὦ ὤ int. O ! Oh ! With voc. Il. 1.74, 158, 442, Il. 2.79, 235, 796, etc. : Od. 1.45, Od. 2.40, Od. 3.43, 79, Od. 4.26, etc. ὤ μοι. ay me! Il. 1.149, Il. 4.370, Il. 7.96, etc. : Od. 5.408, Od. 11.216, Od. 13.168, etc.– ὤ μοι Ὀδυσῆος Od. 20.209 (ay me for . . . !). So ὤ μοι ἐγώ Il. 11.404, etc. : Od. 5.299, etc.– ὤ μοι ἐγὼ σέο Od. 19.363. For ὦ (ὢ) πόποι see πόποι.

ὧδε 1 In this way or manner, thus, so (often (and properly) referring to what concerns the speaker; cf. οὕτως) : ἀπειλήσω τοι ὧδε Il. 1.181, εἰ ἐριδαίνετον ὧδε 574, οὐ τότε γʼ ὧδʼ Ὀδυσῆος ἀγασσάμεθʼ εἶδος (as much as before) Il. 3.224, ὧδε γὰρ ἔβρισαν (so heavily do they bear upon us) Il. 12.346 (or this might come under (3)). Cf. Il. 1.212, Il. 2.258, 271, 802, Il. 4.176, 308, etc. : ὧδʼ ἔρξαι Od. 5.342, ἥμενος ὧδε (sitting here quietly) Od. 18.224, ὄρχους δέ μοι ὧδʼ ὀνόμηνας δώσειν (in the same way, similarly) Od. 24.341. Cf. Od. 1.236, Od. 2.28, 111, Od. 4.159, Od. 9.403, Od. 12.217, etc. 2 With imp., as you are, as I tell you, without more ado, straightway, at once : ὧδʼ ἐπʼ ἀριστέρʼ ἔχε στρατοῦ Il. 13.326. Sim. : οὕνεκά σʼ οὐ τὸ πρῶτον, ἐπεὶ ἴδον, ὧδʼ ἀγάπησα (at once) Od. 23.214. 3 Hither : αἲ γὰρ ὧδʼ ἄφαρ ἐλασαίαθʼ ἵππους Il. 10.537, πρόμολʼ ὧδε Il. 18.392 : ὧδε κατήλυθον Od. 1.182. Cf. Od. 17.544, Od. 21.196. 4 Qualifying an adj., pple. or adv., thus, so : ἀθρόοι ὧδʼ ἴομεν (keeping together as we are) Il. 2.439, ὧδʼ ἀΐδηλος Il. 5.897. Cf. Il. 6.478, Il. 21.358, etc. : ὧδε ἐοικότα Od. 3.125, ὧδʼ ἐκπάγλως Od. 5.339. Cf. Od. 3.376, Od. 4.141, Od. 6.25, Od. 14.139, Od. 19.350, etc. 5 Correlative with ὡς : ὧδε . . . ὡς . . . , in like manner . . . as . . . Il. 3.300, etc. : Od. 3.221, etc.

data.quote: οὐ τότε γʼ ὧδʼ Ὀδυσῆος ἀγασσάμεθʼ εἶδος
ὄρχους δέ μοι ὧδʼ ὀνόμηνας δώσειν
οὕνεκά σʼ οὐ τὸ πρῶτον, ἐπεὶ ἴδον, ὧδʼ ἀγάπησα
αἲ γὰρ ὧδʼ ἄφαρ ἐλασαίαθʼ ἵππους

definition: ᾤδεε 3 sing. impf. οἰδέω.
ὠδίνω [ὠδίς.] 1 To suffer pain, be in agony : στενάχων τε καὶ ὠδίνων ὀδύνῃσιν (in agony of anguish) Od. 9.415. 2 To suffer the pains of child-birth : ὠδίνουσαν γυναῖκα (in labour) Il. 11.269.
ὠδίς -ῖνος, ἡ. In pl., pains, pangs : εἰλείθυιαι πικρὰς ὠδῖνας ἔχουσαι Il. 11.271.
ὠδύσατο 3 sing. aor. ὀδύσσομαι.

ὠθέω [ϝοθ-.] 3 sing. pa. iterative ὤθεσκε Od. 11.596. ὤσασκε Od. 11.599. Aor. ὦσα Od. 9.488. 2 sing. ὦσας Il. 21.398. 3 sing. ἔωσε Il. 16.410. ὦσε Il. 1.220, Il. 2.744, Il. 5.19, Il. 11.143, Il. 13.193, Il. 16.863, Il. 17.618, Il. 20.461, Il. 21.235, etc. : Od. 22.20. 3 pl. ὦσαν Il. 4.535, Il. 5.626, Il. 8.336, Il. 13.148, Il. 16.569, Il. 17.274. 3 sing. subj. ὤσῃ Il. 13.138. 1 pl. opt. ὤσαιμεν Il. 16.45. Infin. ὦσαι Il. 13.688. Mid. 3 sing. aor. ὤσατο Il. 6.62. 1 pl. ὠσάμεθα Il. 8.295. 3 pl. ὤσαντο Il. 16.592. 3 sing. opt. ὤσαιτο Il. 5.691, Il. 16.655. 2 pl. ὤσαισθε Il. 11.803. Infin. ὤσασθαι Il. 12.420, Il. 15.418. (ἀν-, ἀπ-, δι-) 1 To thrust, push, force, shove : ἐς κουλεὸν ξίφος Il. 1.220, ὦσε δʼ ἀπὸ ῥινὸν λίθος (forced it aside) Il. 5.308, ὦσε νεκρούς (i.e. cleared his stream of them) Il. 21.235. Cf. Il. 13.138, Il. 14.494, Il. 15.668 (dispersed it), Il. 17.618 : Od. 3.295, Od. 11.596, 599, Od. 22.20. Of pushing an object by force applied from a position upon it : ὦσα [νῆα] παρέξ Od. 9.488. To thrust (a spear) Il. 21.398. With personal object : ὅτε φῆρας ἐκ πηλίου ὦσεν Il. 2.744, Ἕκτορα Ζεὺς ὦσεν ὄπισθε χειρί (pushed him forwards) Il. 15.694. Cf. Il. 5.19, Il. 16.410, 863, Il. 11.143, 320, Il. 20.461, 489. In mid. with such an object, to thrust back, repulse (a suppliant) : ἀπὸ ἕθεν ὤσατʼ Ἄδρηστον Il. 6.62. 2 To thrust or force back (a foe), cause (him) to give way or retreat : μέγαν ἑ ἐόντα [Ἕκτορʼ] ὦσαν ἀπὸ σφείων Il. 4.535= Il. 5.626= Il. 13.148, ἰθὺς τάφροιο ὦσαν Ἀχαιούς Il. 8.336. Cf. Il. 13.193, 688, Il. 16.45, 569= Il. 17.274, Il. 21.241. In mid. : ὄφρʼ ὤσαιτʼ Ἀργείους Il. 5.691. Cf. Il. 8.295, Il. 11.803, Il. 12.420, Il. 15.418, Il. 16.592, 655. 3 To pull, draw : ἔκ οἱ μηροῦ δόρυ ὦσεν Il. 5.694. Cf. Il. 5.854. With personal object : σθένελον ἀφʼ ἵππων ὦσε χείρʼ ἐρύσασα Il. 5.835.

data.quote: μέγαν ἑ ἐόντα [Ἕκτορʼ] ὦσαν ἀπὸ σφείων
σθένελον ἀφʼ ἵππων ὦσε χείρʼ ἐρύσασα

definition: ὠΐγνυντο 3 pl. impf. pass. οἴγνυμι.
ὠΐετο (ῑ) 3 sing. impf. οἴομαι.
ὤϊξε 3 sing. aor. οἴγνυμι.
ὠΐσθην aor. ὀΐομαι.

ὦκα [ὠκύς.] 1 With speed, swiftly : ὦκα διέπρησσον πεδίοιο Il. 2.785= Il. 3.14. Cf. Il. 5.88, Il. 13.671= Il. 16.606, Il. 21.261, Il. 23.364 : ὦκα μεγάροιο διελθέμεν Od. 6.304. Cf. Od. 3.157, 176, Od. 4.586= Od. 17.149, Od. 15.182, 472, 555, Od. 24.413. 2 In short space, soon, before long, quickly, speedily, shortly : οὐδέ κέ μʼ ὦκα τέλος θανάτοιο κιχείη Il. 9.416. Cf. Il. 5.903, Il. 10.350, Il. 14.418, Il. 17.190, etc. : μάλα δʼ ὦκα δόμους ἵκανεν ἄνακτος Od. 17.255. Cf. Od. 12.427, Od. 14.352, Od. 20.27, Od. 21.50, etc. 3 Without delay or loss of time, with all speed, at once, forthwith, straightway : ὦχʼ ἑκατόγχειρον καλέσασα Il. 1.402. Cf. Il. 1.447, Il. 2.26, 52, Il. 7.337, 417, Il. 11.354, etc. : ὦκʼ ἐνήσομεν πόντῳ Od. 2.295. Cf. Od. 2.8, Od. 6.289, Od. 10.178, Od. 14.33, Od. 18.39, etc.

data.quote: οὐδέ κέ μʼ ὦκα τέλος θανάτοιο κιχείη
μάλα δʼ ὦκα δόμους ἵκανεν ἄνακτος

definition: ὠκύαλος -ον [app. a lengthened form of ὠκύς.] Swift. Epithet of ships Il. 15.705 : Od. 12.182, Od. 15.473.

ὠκύμορος [ὠκύς + μόρος.] 1 On whom fate is coming swiftly, doomed to an early death, short-lived : ὠκύμορος καὶ ὀϊζυρός Il. 1.417. Cf. Il. 18.95, 458: Od. 1.266= Od. 4.346= Od. 17.137. In superl. : ὠκυμορώτατος ἄλλων Il. 1.505. 2 Carrying swift death. Epithet of arrows Il. 15.441: Od. 22.75.
ὠκυπέτης [ὠκύς + πέτομαι.] Swift-flying, swift-speeding : ἵππω Il. 8.42= Il. 13.24.
ὠκύπορος -ον [ὠκύς + -πορος, πείρω.] Swiftly cleaving (the seas), swift-sailing. Epithet of ships Il. 1.421, Il. 2.351, Il. 10.308, Il. 12.156, etc. : Od. 4.708, Od. 5.176, Od. 14.230.

ὠκύπους -ποδος [ὠκύς + πούς.] Dat. pl. ὠκυπόδεσσι Il. 2.383, Il. 23.504. Swift-footed. Epithet of horses Il. 2.383, Il. 5.296, 732, Il. 10.535, etc. : Od. 23.245. Applied to ἵπποι in sense chariot (see ἵππος (3)) Il. 8.129 : Od. 18.263.
ὠκύπτερος [ὠκύς + πτερόν.] Swift - winged. Epithet of the falcon : ἴρηξ Il. 13.62.
ὠκύροος [ὠκύς + ῥέω.] Swift-flowing : ποταμῷ Il. 5.598. Cf. Il. 7.133.

ὠκύς [-εῖα], -ύ. Nom. sing. fem. always in form ὠκέα Il. 2.786, Il. 5.368, Il. 8.425, Il. 11.195, etc. : Od. 12.374. Superl. ὠκύτατος Od. 8.331. ὤκιστος Il. 15.238, Il. 21.253, Il. 22.325 : Od. 22.77, 133. 1 Quick in movement, nimble, swift, fleet (often a merely conventional epithet) : ὀϊστόν Il. 5.395, ἴρηκι Il. 15.238. Cf. Il. 5.106, Il. 11.397, Il. 16.583, etc. : τῶν νέες ὠκεῖαι ὡς εἰ πτερόν Od. 7.36. Cf. Od. 6.104, Od. 12.374, Od. 21.138, 416, etc. Absol. : κιχάνει βραδὺς ὠκύν Od. 8.329. In superl. : ὤκιστος πετεηνῶν Il. 15.238, Il. 21.253. Cf. Od. 8.331. Of immaterial things : ὠκὺς θυμὸς πτάτο (flew swiftly) Il. 23.880. In superl. : ὤκιστος ὄλεθρος Il. 22.325. Epithet of horses Il. 3.263, Il. 4.500, Il. 5.257, Il. 7.240, etc. : Od. 3.478, 496, Od. 4.28. Applied to ἵπποι in sense chariot (see ἵππος (3)) Il. 7.15. Of ships Il. 8.197 : Od. 7.34, Od. 9.101. Epithet of Achilles Il. 19.295, Il. 21.211, Il. 22.188, etc. Of Iris Il. 2.786, Il. 5.368, Il. 11.195, etc. For πόδας ὠκύς (ὠκέα) see πούς 3. 2 In neut. pl. superl. ὤκιστα as adv., very soon, speedily, at once : εἴ κε βοὴ ὤκιστα γένοιτο Od. 22.77. Cf. Od. 22.133.

data.quote: τῶν νέες ὠκεῖαι ὡς εἰ πτερόν

definition: ὤλεσα aor. ὄλλυμι.
ὠλεσίκαρπος -ον [ὠλεσ-, ὄλλυμι + καρπός1.] Shedding its fruit early : ἰτέαι Od. 10.510.
ὤλετο 3 sing. aor. mid. ὄλλυμι.
ὤλξ [ϝελκ-, (ϝ)έλκω.] Only in acc. ὦλκα. A furrow : ἱεμένω κατὰ ὦλκα Il. 13.707. Cf. Od. 18.375.
ὠμηστής [ὠμός + ἔδω.] Eating raw flesh, preying on carrion : οἰωνοί Il. 11.454, κύνες Il. 22.67, ἰχθύσιν Il. 24.82. Applied to a human being : ὠμηστὴς ἀνὴρ ὅ γε Il. 24.207.
ὡμίλευν 3 pl. impf. ὁμιλέω.
ὠμογέρων -οντος [ὠμός in sense unripe + γέρων.] In green or lusty old age Il. 23.791.

ὠμοθετέω [ὠμός + θε-, τίθημι.] In sacrificing, to lay slices of raw flesh on the fat enclosing the sacrificial joints : ἐπʼ αὐτῶν (i.e. on the joints so enclosed) ὠμοθέτησαν Il. 1.461= Il. 2.424 := Od. 3.458= Od. 12.361. In mid. : ὠμοθετεῖτο συβώτης ἐς πίονα δημόν Od. 14.427.

ὠμός 1 Uncooked, raw : ὠμὰ κρέα ἔδμεναι Il. 22.347 : κρέʼ ὀπταλέα τε καὶ ὠμά Od. 12.396. So εἰ ὠμὸν βεβρώθοις Πρίαμον Il. 4.35. Fig. : ἐν ὠμῷ γήραϊ θῆκεν (premature) Od. 15.357. 2 Raw, with the skin stripped off, excoriated, bloody : ὅς κε μήδεʼ ἐξερύσας δώῃ κυσὶν ὠμὰ δάσασθαι Od. 18.87. Cf. Od. 22.476. In neut. pl. as adv. (though in sense qualifying rather the object than the vb.) : Ἕκτορα δώσειν κυσὶν ὠμὰ δάσασθαι Il. 23.21.

data.quote: ὅς κε μήδεʼ ἐξερύσας δώῃ κυσὶν ὠμὰ δάσασθαι

definition: ὦμος -ου, ὁ. 1 One of the shoulders, one's shoulder; in dual and pl., the shoulders, one's shoulders : τόξʼ ὤμοισιν ἔχων Il. 1.45, τώ οἱ ὤμω κυρτώ Il. 2.217, διʼ ὤμου ἔγχος ἦλθεν Il. 4.481. Cf. Il. 1.46, Il. 3.17, Il. 5.7, 46, 622, Il. 7.16, Il. 11.593, etc. : Od. 2.3, Od. 4.245, Od. 6.219, Od. 8.416, 528, Od. 10.170, 262, 362, etc. Of animals. Of horses Il. 6.510= Il. 15.267, Il. 16.468. Of a wild boar Od. 19.452. 2 Regarded as a seat of strength : ἐν βίην ὤμοισιν ἔθηκεν Il. 17.569.
ὤμοσα aor. ὄμνυμι.
ὠμοφάγος [ὠμός + φάγον.] Eating, preying upon, raw flesh, ravening : λείουσιν Il. 5.782, Il. 7.256, Il. 15.592, θῶες Il. 11.479, λύκοι Il. 16.157.
ὤμωξε 3 sing. aor. οἰμώζω.
ὤνατο 3 sing. aor. ὄνομαι.
ὤνησε 3 sing. aor. ὀνίνημι.
ὠνητός -ή, -όν [ὠνέομαι, to buy, fr. ὦνος.] Bought : ἔμʼ ὠνητὴ τέκε μήτηρ, παλλακίς (i.e. a slave) Od. 14.202.
ὠνόμασας 2 sing. aor. ὀνομάζω.

ὦνος -ου, ὁ. (ϝῶνος. Cf. L. nenum.) That which is given or paid as an equivalent, a price: ὦνον ἔδωκεν Il. 21.41, υἷος Πριάμοιο ὦνον ἔδωκε [κρητῆρα] (as the ransom for him; referring to the same transaction) Il. 23.746 : ἐπείγετʼ ὦνον ὁδαίων (i.e. your buying, your bargaining) Od. 15.445. Cf. Od. 14.297, Od. 15.388 = 429, 452, 463.
ὠνοσάμην aor. ὄνομαι.
ᾦξε 3 sing. aor. οἴγνυμι.

ὦπα τό [ὀπ-. See ὁράω.] (Cf. βλοσυρῶπις, βοῶπις, γλαυκῶπις, εἰσωπός, ἑλίκωψ, ἐνῶπα, ἐνώπια, εὐῶπις, κυανῶπις, κυνώπης, κυνῶπις, μέτωπον, πρόσωπον, στεινωπός, ὑπώπια.) The eye (always with εἰς) : θεῇς εἰς ὦπα ἔοικεν (looking at her in the eye, to view) Il. 3.158, ἔμοιγε εἰς ὦπα ἰδέσθαι (to look me in the eye) Il. 9.373, ἐπὴν Διὸς εἰς ὦπα ἴδησθε Il. 15.147. Cf. Od. 1.411, Od. 22.405, Od. 23.107.
ὤπασα aor. ὀπάζω.
ὥπλισσε 3 sing. aor. ὁπλίζω.
ὤρεξε 3 sing. aor. ὀρέγω.
ὤρεσσι contr. dat. pl. ὄαρ.
ὤρετο 3 sing. aor. mid. ὄρνυμι.

ὥρη -ης, ἡ. 1 A natural season, a period of the year : ὅσσα τε φύλλα γίγνεται ὥρῃ (in their season, i.e. in spring) Il. 2.468, ὥρῃ ἐν εἰαρινῇ 471= Il. 16.643. Cf. Il. 6.148, Il. 21.450 : βαθύ κε λήϊον εἰς ὥρας ἀμῷεν (in due season) Od. 9.135. Cf. Od. 2.107 =Od. 19.152 = Od. 24.142, Od. 9.51, Od. 10.469, Od. 11.295 = Od. 14.294, Od. 18.367 = Od. 22.301. Personified. In pl. Ὧραι Il. 5.749 = Il. 8.393, Il. 8.433. A season or time marked by special characteristics : ὥρῃ χειμερίῃ (in storm-time) Od. 5.485, ὁππότε Διὸς ὧραι ἐπιβρίσειαν (the rainy seasons, rain-showers) Od. 24.344. 2 The season or time for something : ὥρη εὕδειν Od. 11.330, 373, ὥρη δόρποιο Od. 14.407, ἐν ὥρῃ (in the due season) Od. 17.176. Cf. Od. 3.334, Od. 11.379, Od. 15.126, 394, Od. 19.510, Od. 21.428.

data.quote: βαθύ κε λήϊον εἰς ὥρας ἀμῷεν

definition: ὤρινε 3 sing. aor. ὀρίνω.
ὥριος [ὥρη.] Proper to a season : φέροι κεν ὥρια πάντα (all things in due season) Od. 9.131.
ὤριστος crasis of ὁ ἄριστος.
ὤρορε 3 sing. redup. aor. ὄρνυμι.
ὦσε 3 sing. aor. ὄρνυμι.
ὦρτο 3 sing. aor. mid. ὄρνυμι.
ὠρχεῦντο 3 pl. impf. ὀρχέομαι.
ὠρώρει 3 sing. plupf. ὄρνυμι.

ὥς Written also ὧς. 1 In this way or manner, thus, so : ὣς ἔφατο Il. 1.33, ὣς τὰ πένοντο 318, αἲ γὰρ ἐγὼν ὣς εἴην ἀθάνατος ὡς . . . (as surely as . . .) Il. 8.538. Cf. Il. 1.68, 217, Il. 2.35, 207, Il. 14.142 (by his own folly) , etc. : Od. 1.42, 96, 125, 166, Od. 2.106, 320, Od. 3.148, 228, etc. With αὔτως. See αὔτως 2. 2 Absol. a καὶ ὥς, even so, all the same, nevertheless, for all thatIl. 1.116, Il. 3.159, Il. 4.322, Il. 5.482, Il. 8.56, etc. : Od. 4.484, Od. 5.219, Od. 8.184, Od. 9.258, etc. b οὐδʼ ὥς, not even so, for all thatIl. 7.263, Il. 9.351, 386, Il. 11.255, Il. 12.432, etc. : Od. 1.6, Od. 2.23, Od. 5.324, Od. 10.291, etc. 3 Qualifying an adjective or pple., thus, so : ὣς πυκνοὶ ἀλλήλοισιν ἔφυν ἐπαμοιβαδίς Od. 5.480. Cf. Od. 13.389, Od. 18.202, Od. 19.442. 4 Thus, so, therefore, accordingly : ὣς λίπον [ἵππους] Il. 5.204. Cf. Il. 1.601, Il. 9.597, etc. : ὣς οὐκ αἰνότερον ἄλλο γυναικός (thus we see that . . .) Od. 11.427. Cf. Od. 2.137, Od. 4.93, Od. 9.161, etc. 5 Correlative with ὡς : a ὣς . . . ὡς . . ., so . . . as . . . Il. 4.319, Il. 8.538, Il. 11.670, Il. 14.265, etc. : Od. 3.218, Od. 6.166, Od. 10.416, Od. 14.468, Od. 15.156, etc. b ὡς . . . ὣς . . . α As . . . so . . . Il. 1.513, Il. 2.328, 464, Il. 4.314, 436, Il. 5.163, Il. 7.7, Il. 8.308, Il. 11.70, Il. 12.171, etc. : Od. 4.340, Od. 5.330, 370, Od. 8.531, Od. 10.218, 414, Od. 13.84, Od. 17.218 (see ὁμοῖος 1), etc. β No sooner . . . than . . . Il. 14.294, Il. 19.16, Il. 20.424.

data.quote: αἲ γὰρ ἐγὼν ὣς εἴην ἀθάνατος ὡς . . .

definition: ὡς 1 In such or the same way or manner as, even as, as. a α ὡς ἔμʼ ἀφαιρεῖται Χρυσηΐδα (as he is taking her from me, (so) will I . . .) Il. 1.182, ὡς ἔσεταί περ 211, ὡς ἐπιτέλλω Il. 2.10. Cf. Il. 1.276, Il. 2.258, Il. 4.267, 374, Il. 6.262, 519, Il. 8.286, etc. : δὸς ξείνιον ὥς περ ὑπέστης Od. 9.365, αἲ γὰρ δυναίμην . . . ὡς . . . (as surely as . . .) 525. Cf. Od. 1.35, 200, Od. 2.172, 183, 305, Od. 3.234, Od. 4.157, etc. So ὥς τε : ὥς τέ τευ ἤ παρὰ πάμπαν ἀνείμονος ἠὲ πενιχροῦ (as if from . . .) Od. 3.348, ὥς τε περὶ ψυχῆς (as was natural in a matter of life and death) Od. 9.423. Cf. Od. 6.122, Od. 11.411, etc. β Introducing similes : ὡς Il. 5.499, Il. 7.4, Il. 9.4, Il. 11.113, etc. : Od. 19.205, Od. 20.14.– ὥς τε Il. 2.459, Il. 3.23, Il. 4.433, Il. 12.421, etc. : Od. 13.81. For ὡς ὁπότε see ὁπότε 1.a. For ὡς ὅτε see ὅτε 1.a.γ. γ For ὡς γάρ see γάρ 4. b With subj. α In conditional relative sentences. For the examples and construction see Table at end (III) (D) (13) (35). β Introducing similes : ὡς Il. 5.161, Il. 9.323, Il. 22.93, etc. : Od. 5.368, Od. 8.523, Od. 16.17.– ὥς τε Il. 2.474, Il. 11.67, Il. 12.167, Il. 13.198, etc. : Od. 22.302. For ὡς ὁπότε see ὁπότε 1.b.γ.–For ὡς ὅτε see ὅτε 1.b.δ. c Introducing a simile with opt. : ὡς ὅτε Od. 9.384. d For ὡς εἰ, ὡς εἴ τε see εἰ 6, εἰ 7. 2 Introducing similes without expressed vb. : ὡς Il. 17.4, Il. 21.282.– ὥς τε Il. 5.136, Il. 9.14, Il. 12.299, Il. 15.630, etc. : Od. 1.308, Od. 6.130, Od. 22.384, etc. For ὡς ὅτε see ὅτε 2. 3 Introducing a clause reduced to its subject or object, after the manner of, as in the case of, in the likeness of, like. a ὡς : ὥς περ Ἀχιλλεύς Il. 14.50, ὡς Πάτροκλον Il. 19.403, etc. : ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή Od. 6.20. Cf. Od. 2.333, Od. 7.206, Od. 12.433, Od. 15.479, Od. 20.140, etc. b ὥς τε : ὥς τε θεός (as might be expected of a goddess) Il. 3.381, ὥς τε λέοντα Il. 5.136. Cf. Il. 2.289, Il. 9.14, Il. 11.239, Il. 13.564, etc. : ὥς τε κτάμεναι μενεαίνων (like one minded to . . .) Od. 10.295, ὥς τε θεῷ Od. 22.349. Cf. Od. 1.227, Od. 3.246, Od. 4.45, Od. 5.371, etc.–. 4 Following the word to which it relates and accented : κακὸν ὥς Il. 2.190, ὄρνιθας ὥς 764. Cf. Il. 2.781, Il. 3.60, 196, Il. 5.78, Il. 8.306, etc. : ἀθάνατος ὥς Od. 6.309. Cf. Od. 1.320, Od. 2.47, Od. 4.32, Od. 10.124, etc. 5 In what way or manner, in how high a degree. In exclamatory use, how . . . ! to think how . . . ! to think that . . . ! ὡς οὔ τίς με θεῶν ὑπέστη σαῶσαι Il. 21.273. Cf. Il. 21.441, Il. 24.388 : ὡς ὅδε πᾶσι φίλος ἐστίν Od. 10.38, ὡς ἐπιτροχάδην ἀγορεύει Od. 18.26. Cf. Od. 15.381, Od. 16.364. Sim. : ὥς μοι δέχεται κακὸν ἐκ κακοῦ (showing how . . .) Il. 19.290 : ὡς ἀγαθὸν καὶ παῖδα λιπέσθαι (from which we see how good a thing it is) Od. 3.196, ὡς οὐδὲν γλύκιον ἧς πατρίδος (so true it is that . . .) Od. 9.34. Cf. Od. 22.319. 6 In object clauses, in what way or manner, to what extent, in what degree, how. a With indic. : ᾔδεε γὰρ ἀδελφεὸν ὡς ἐπονεῖτο Il. 2.409, μέμνημαι τόδε ἔργον ὡς ἦν (how it chanced) Il. 9.528. Cf. Il. 4.360, Il. 7.407, Il. 9.647, Il. 11.768, Il. 14.482, Il. 15.204, Il. 23.648, etc. : ἀκούσαμεν ὡς ἐβόησας Od. 4.281, οὐ τόλμησεν ἐπακοῦσαι ἐμὸν ἔπος, ὡς ἐρέεινον . . . (i. e. would not stay to learn the nature of my inquiry) Od. 24.262. Cf. Od. 3.194, 255, Od. 4.772, Od. 5.423, Od. 8.76, Od. 13.170, Od. 22.374, Od. 23.310, etc. With fut. : εἰπέ μοι νόστον, ὡς ἐλεύσομαι Od. 4.381. Cf. Od. 4.390, etc. b With subj. (here and in c tending to pass into sense (8)). α Pure : μερμήριζε ὡς Ἀχιλῆα τιμήσῃ Il. 2.3. β With κεν: πειρᾶν ὥς κʼ ἄρξωσιν Il. 4.66. Cf. Il. 9.112, Il. 15.235, Il. 21.459, etc. : φράσσεται ὥς κε νέηται Od. 1.205. Cf. Od. 1.87, Od. 2.168, 316, etc. c With opt. : πειρᾶν ὡς πεπίθοιεν Πηλεΐωνα Il. 9.181. 7 In such way or manner that, so that. a With subj. pure or with κεν or ἄν : ὥς τις βέλος πέσσῃ Il. 8.513, ὡς ἂν δοάσσεται Il. 23.339 : ὥς κʼ ἄλγεα πάσχῃ Od. 22.177. Cf. Od. 16.169. b With opt. α Pure : ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι Od. 18.91. Cf. Od. 9.42 = 549. β With ἄν: ὡς ἄν τίς σε μακαρίζοι Od. 15.538=Od. 17.165=Od. 19.311. 8 Infinal clauses, so that, in order that. a With subj. α Pure : ὥς μοι τόνδʼ ἄνδρʼ ἐξονομήνῃς Il. 3.166. Cf. Il. 2.363, Il. 6.259, 357, Il. 8.37, Il. 9.311, etc. : Od. 5.164, Od. 17.76. β With κεν: σαώτερος ὥς κε νέηαι Il. 1.32. Cf. Il. 2.385, Il. 6.69, Il. 7.334, Il. 8.508, Il. 19.151, Il. 24.75, etc. : ὥς κʼ ἔμʼ ἐμῆς ἐπιβήσετε πάτρης Od. 7.223. Cf. Od. 2.368, Od. 5.26, Od. 8.101, Od. 19.319, Od. 24.532, etc. γ With ἄν: ὡς ἄν μοι τιμὴν ἄρηαι Il. 16.84. Cf. Il. 16.271 : ὡς ἂν μὴ κατὰ χρόα ἰάπτῃ Od. 2.376. Cf. Od. 4.672, 749, Od. 13.402, Od. 16.84, Od. 24.360. b With opt. α Pure : ὡς ἀκούσειαν Il. 2.281. Cf. Il. 5.24, Il. 9.461, Il. 21.605, etc. : ὡς χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο Od. 3.145. Cf. Od. 6.113, 129, Od. 14.297. β With κεν: ὥς κʼ αὐτὸς ἐεδνώσαιτο θύγατρα Od. 2.53. Cf. Od. 8.21, Od. 23.135, Od. 24.83. γ With ἄν: ὡς ἄν μοι παῖδα σκυρόθεν ἐξαγάγοις Il. 19.331 : ὡς ἂν ἐπιθύσαντες ἑλοίμεθα Od. 16.297. Cf. Od. 17.362. 9 In which way, i.e. wherefore, and so : ὡς ἂν ἀπὸ σεῖο οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι λείπεσθαι Il. 9.444. Cf. Il. 21.291. 10 ὥς τε with infin., so as to . . . : οὐ γὰρ ἔτι τηλίκος εἰμί, ὥς τε σημάντορι πιθέσθαι Od. 17.21. This construction where the simple infin. might be expected : εἴ τοι θυμὸς ἐπέσσυται ὥς τε νέεσθαι Il. 9.42. 11 Seeing how, in what way or manner, to what extent, in what degree, seeing that thus (= ὅτι οὕτως): ὡς ἐλέλιχθεν Il. 6.109, ὡς ἀγορεύεις (as to judge by your speech you think them to be) Il. 9.41, ὡς πυκνοὶ ἐφέστασαν ἀλλήλοισιν (so close together did they stand) Il. 13.133. Cf. Il. 4.157, Il. 9.689, Il. 10.116, Il. 11.689, Il. 15.698, Il. 16.17, 600 (when they saw how he had fallen), etc. : ὡς οὔ τις μέμνηται Ὀδυσσῆος Od. 2.233, ὡς δὴ δήθʼ ἐνὶ νήσῳ ἐρύκεαι (seeing that so long . . .) Od. 4.373, ὡς ὄνομʼ ἐξαπάτησεν (to think how . . .) Od. 9.414, θαῦμά μʼ ἔχει ὡς . . . (to see how . . .) Od. 10.326, ὥς οἱ ἔειπεν Ἀθηναίη (reassured by her speech) Od. 13.251, ὡς ἐπάγοντες ἐπῇσαν (with such a din did they . . .) Od. 19.445. Cf. Od. 4.841, Od. 11.419, Od. 19.230, Od. 21.123, Od. 24.194, 512, etc. 12 When, after that, as soon as : ὡς ἴδον Il. 1.600. Cf. Il. 2.321, Il. 3.21, Il. 4.149, Il. 6.237, 374, Il. 18.222, etc. : φαῖνεν ἀοιδήν, ἔνθεν ἑλὼν ὡς ἀπέπλειον (from the point when they had . . .) Od. 8.500, ὡς ἐνόησεν Od. 10.375. Cf. Od. 3.34, Od. 8.272, Od. 22.148, etc. 13 With opt. expressing a wish : ὡς ἔρις ἀπόλοιτο Il. 18.107. Cf. Il. 22.286 : ὡς ἔλθοι Od. 17.243= Od. 21.201. Cf. Od. 1.47. Anomalously with κεν : ὥς κέ οἱ γαῖα χάνοι Il. 6.281 (app., O that the earth could gape for him). For ὡς ὤφελον (ὄφελον), ὡς ὤφελλον, see ὀφέλλω1 5. 14 Introducing a dependent substantive-clause, that, how : ἀγορεύεις ὡς . . . Il. 1.110. Cf. Il. 1.558, Il. 7.402, Il. 10.160, Il. 17.450, Il. 22.10, Il. 23.611, etc. : ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὡς . . . Od. 2.312. Cf. Od. 3.347, Od. 4.377, Od. 5.24, Od. 9.443, Od. 14.152, Od. 17.157, Od. 19.94, Od. 21.209, Od. 22.351, Od. 23.60, etc. Introducing a clause with opt. in oratio obliqua : ἕκαστα εἰπεῖν, ὡς ἔλθοι (that he had come) Od. 24.237. 15 In Od. 17.218 (ὡς αἰεὶ τὸν ὁμοῖον ἄγει θεὸς ὣς τὸν ὁμοῖον) if ὡς be read for ὥς it must app. be taken as = εἰς or πρός. See ὁμοῖος 1. 16 Correlative with οὕτως. See οὕτως 1. With τόσσον. See τόσος 5.d. With τώς. See τώς 2. With ὧδε. See ὧδε 5. With ὥς. See ὥς 5.

definition: ὦσα aor. ὠθέω.
ὠσί dat. pl. See οὖας.
ὠτειλή -ῆς, ἡ. A wound : ἔρρεεν αἷμʼ ἐξ ὠτειλῆς Il. 4.140. Cf. Il. 11.266, Il. 14.518, Il. 16.862, Il. 17.297, Il. 18.351, etc. : Od. 10.164, Od. 19.456, Od. 24.189.
ὠτώεις -εντος [ὠτ-, οὖς, οὖας.] Furnished with ears or handles (cf. οὖας 2) : τρίποδα Il. 23.264, 513.
ωὐτός crasis of ὁ αὐτός. See αὐτός 3.
ὤφελε 3 sing. aor. ὀφέλλω1.
ὤφελλε1 3 sing. impf. ὀφέλλω1.
ὤφελλε,2, 3 sing. impf. ὀφέλλω2.
ᾤχετο 3 sing. impf. οἴχομαι.
ὠχράω [ὦχρος.] To turn pale or pallid : ὠχρήσαντα χρόα κάλλιμον Od. 11.529.
ὦχρος ὁ. Paleness, pallor : ὦχρός μιν εἷλε παρειάς Il. 3.35.
ἀ-1. Before a vowel ἀν-. Also in assimilated form ἀμ- (only in Il. 17.695 : = Od. 4.704). Negative or privative.
ἀ-2. [(σ)α- as in ἅμα.] Copulative or sociative, indicating united or continuous action; contiguity, closeness; equivalence.
ἀγα- [ἄγαν, very, much.] Intensive.
ἀμφι- Before a vowel ἀμφ-. Also ἀμπ-. 1 On both sides. 2 Having two, double. 3 Round, about; all round or about. 4 About, concerning.

ἀνα- Before a vowel ἀν-. Also in assimilated forms ἀγ-, ἀϝ-, ἀλ-, ἀμ-. 1 Up, upwards; also of putting to sea. 2 On, upon. 3 Back; in a reverse direction. 4 Again; return to a state; repetition. 5 Through, over, among; diffusion. 6 Intensive, sometimes translatable by up, on, out (in some cases not appreciably affecting the sense).

ἀντι- Before a vowel ἀντ-. Also in assimilated form ἀνθ-. 1 Over against, opposite. 2 Against, whether in opposition or for protection. 3 Before one, onwards. 4 Equal to, the equivalent of, as good as.

ἀπο- Before a vowel ἀπ-. Also in assimilated form ἀφ-. 1 Away, off, from, away from. 2 Far away, away, at a distance. 3 Asunder, in two. 4 Back, backwards; restoration. 5 Giving notion of requiting. 6 With negative sense; undoing or reversing action. 7 Intensive (in some cases not appreciably affecting the sense).
ἀρι- Intensive.
δα- [δια- 10. Cf. ζα-.] Intensive.

δια- Before a vowel δι-. 1 Through; piercing. 2 Traversing. 3 Across; crossing. 4 In all directions. 5 Severing, sundering; in pieces. 6 Separation; putting, keeping or being apart. 7 Distinguishing. 8 Continuity; doing something constantly; continuous succession. 9 Exhaustiveness, in full, fully. 10 Intensive (in some cases not appreciably affecting the sense).
δισ- [δύο.] Also in form δι-. Twice; double.
δυσ- 1 Giving a word an unfavourable sense, or giving a sense of ill-luck or unhappiness. 2 Intensive of words having such senses.

εἰσ- Also ἐσ-. 1 To, towards; or reinforcing this notion when already implicit. 2 Into, in. 3 On, on to. 4 Giving notion of a directing of the mind, sight, etc., in a particular way, or reinforcing this notion when already implicit.

ἐκ- Before a vowel ἐξ-. 1 Out, forth, from, away. 2 Indicating origin or source. 3 Indicating separation; off. 4 Indicating suspension from or attachment to something. 5 Indicating standing out from others or prominence, or reinforcing this idea. 6 Indicating extension as in hammering; out. 7 Indicating excess; beyond. 8 Of speaking, etc., indicating absence of restraint; out, right out, aloud. 9 Intensive (often not appreciably affecting the sense).

ἐν- Also in forms εἰν-, ἐνι-, and in assimilated forms ἐγ-, ἐμ-. 1 In (in local and immaterial senses). Also (as in ἔνορχος, ἐνῶπα) indicating the presence in something of what is indicated by the second element. 2 Into (in local and immaterial senses). 3 On, upon, on to; also in hostile sense. 4 Among. 5 Towards. 6 Intensive (commonly not appreciably affecting the sense).
ἐξ- See ἐκ-.

ἐπι- Before a vowel ἐπ-. Also in assimilated form ἐφ-. 1 Position on or upon something or on or in the surface of something. 2 At, by, in, among. 3 Placing, fitting or attaching in a specified or indicated position. 4 Denoting an occasion or cause, at, in, thereat, thereupon, therein. 5 Denoting (sometimes vaguely) that action, effort or the like takes place in a specified or indicated direction or is directed to or against something or to a specified or indicated object or end. 6 Besides, in addition. 7 Following, succession; being behind. 8 Accompaniment. 9 In answer or response. 10 Being in charge of something. 11 To, towards, at, on, upon, for. So in hostile sense. 12 On to, on, upon, over. 13 Over, passing over. 14 Going over or along a space or line or over or round persons, etc. 15 Extension or diffusion over a space. 16 Extension over a period of time. 17 On, onwards. 18 Putting to, closing, shutting; thrusting or pressing home. 19 Intensive (commonly not appreciably affecting the sense).
ἐρι- Intensive.
ἐσ- See εἰσ-.

εὐ- ἐϋ- Also ἠϋ. 1 In adjectives and verbs, well, excellently, skilfully, duly; denoting also goodness of birth, facility in doing something, approval. 2 In adjectives, well or rightly in a moral sense. 3 In adjectives, denoting the conferring of services or benefit. 4 In adjectives, showing the quality in a high degree. 5 In adjectives and substantives, denoting the presence, in a high degree of goodness, excellence, beauty, well-being, benevolence or amount, of what is signified by the second element of the compound.
ζα- [δα-, δια- 10.] Intensive.
ἡμι- [Cf. L. semi-.] Half-.

κατα- Before a vowel κατ-. Also in forms καται-, κα-, and in assimilated forms καβ-, καδ-, καθ-, κακ-, καλ-, καμ-, καν-, καπ-. 1 Down, downwards, down from, down upon, down along; reinforcing the noting when already present; also of coming in from sea. 2 Indicating that an action or agency is directed against or prejudicially affects a person. 3 Indicating traversing a space or extension over it. 4 According to, by. 5 Intensive (commonly not appreciably affecting the sense).

μετα- Before a vowel μετ-. Also in assimilated form μεθ-. 1 Motion in quest of , after, in pursuit of, following. 2 Position between. 3 Among, in company with, with. 4 Position behind. 5 After in time, after, later. 6 Change of position, fortune, circumstances, etc. 7 Alternation, taking turns, occurrence of intervals.
νη- Negative or privative.
ξυν- ξυμ- For words with these prefixes see the same words with συν-, συμ-.

παρα- παραι- Also in form παρ-. 1 From. 2 Beside, by, near. 3 Past, passing by. 4 Aside, away; denoting turning or bending of a person's mind or will. 5 Difference; denoting the converse of something.

περι- 1 Of position, round, about, round about. 2 Motion round or about; revolving motion. 3 More than others; exceeding, excelling, surpassing. 4 Excess. 5 On account of, touching, in regard to, for. 6 Intensive.
ποτι- See προσ-.

προ- 1 Forward, forwards, forth. 2 In front, before; denoting excelling or surpassing, preference or choice. 3 In reference to time, before, beforehand. 4 Reinforcing the notion denoted by the second element; intensive.

προσ- Also προτι-, ποτι-. 1 At, by, beside, on, upon, against. 2 To, towards, against. In reference to speech, to. 3 Denoting (sometimes vaguely) that action, effort or the like takes place in a specified or indicated direction or is directed to or against something or to a specified or indicated object or end.
προτι- See προσ-.

συν- ξυν- Also in assimilated forms συγ-, συλ-, συμ-, συρ-. 1 With, along with. 2 Together; denoting joining, union, contact, proximity. 3 Together; in a body or mass; in confusion. 4 Altogether; intensive.
ὑπερ- Also in form ὑπειρ-. 1 Position above or over. 2 Passing over. 3 Passing over and beyond. 4 Beyond, contrary to, in defiance of. 5 Intensive; excelling. 6 Indicating excess.

ὑπο- Before a vowel ὑπ-. Also in assimilated forms ὑβ-, ὑφ-. 1 From under something. 2 In reference to direction, from beneath or below. 3 From the power, reach or range of something. 4 Under, beneath or below something. 5 Under the power or orders of someone. 6 In reference to conception or the bearing of offspring indicating the submission of the female to the male. 7 Indicating coming under an obligation or undertaking. 8 To underneath something.– 9 Motion beneath something. 10 Returning, coming back. 11 Indicating a coming or an instilling into the mind or heart. 12 Indicating (sometimes vaguely) occasion, cause, purpose, correspondence, concurrence, competition, response, relationship, contrast, or the like.
-δε enclitic. 1 Motion towards. 2 Purpose. 3 Intensive.
-θεν Also -θε. 1 Motion from; from in gen. 2 Position away from; position indicated by the first element of the compound.
-θι Place at or in which; time when.
-σε Motion towards; place whither.
